機動兵器アスクレプスを駆る謎の青年。\n 「人類の進化を見守る者」を自称するク.en:
A mysterious young man who pilots the mobile weapon $$アスクレプス$$.
As the action captain of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists, who call themselves 'those who watch over humanity's evolution', he serves as the Reformists' de facto leader.
He always wears a warm smile and has a gentle, graceful bearing.
The true aims of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists and of the man himself are unknown, but toward $$ジェミニス$$, the hidden power behind the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, he faced them with a resolute attitude, at times taking a stance that could even be called arrogant.
Calling himself one of the 'cursed', he says he is a person from another world who is chasing the '$$テンシ$$', but in the final battle with $$ジェミニス$$, he gave up his life with his aims unfulfilled, in order to break $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s $$スフィア$$ of the '$$いがみ合う双子$$'.

並行世界の一つ（＝『第２次スーパーロボット大戦Ｚ』の世界）。\n その名は「西.en:
One of the parallel worlds (= the world of 'The 2nd Super Robot Wars Z').
The name is short for 'Anno Domini World'.
Its situation was comparatively stable, but twenty years after the $$大時空震動$$ it was struck by two inter-dimensional wars in succession: the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$.
It is marked by two Japanese archipelagos, two moons, and a continent sealed off by a dimensional wall. The wall covering that continent vanished early in the $$破界事変$$, and one of the two moons vanished late in the $$再世戦争$$.

トップレスが年齢を重ねることで超・能力を失うこと。\n 完全に喪失した時は「あ.en:
The loss of super-abilities by a $$トップレス$$ as they grow older.
When the ability has been completely lost, it is said that they have 'reached $$あがり$$'.
The $$トップレス$$ ability reaches its maximum in adolescence, then gradually declines as the person approaches adulthood and is eventually lost.

フルネームはアイム・ライアード。\n 「偽りの黒羊」のスフィアの所持者で、機動.en:
Full name $$アイム#keyword$$ Liard.
Holder of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and the man who pilots the mobile weapon $$アリエティス$$.
In the $$破界事変$$ he summoned $$ガイオウ$$, $$破界の王$$, to sow chaos in the world, and worked in the shadows as a staff officer of the $$新帝国インペリウム$$.
He was believed killed in the battle at the South Pole late in the $$破界事変$$, but that death was a mimicry produced by his $$スフィア$$'s power.
For his own ends he supplied dimensional science to $$インサラウム$$'s $$アンブローン・ジウス$$. Most of his intent is unknown, but behind his joining of the two worlds through the $$アビス$$ late in the $$再世戦争$$ there seems to lie something beyond merely hunting other $$スフィア$$ holders.
The $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$ governs human falsehood, and its holder's words and deeds are so full of lies that his true feelings are hard to grasp. He is also half absorbed into the $$スフィア$$, and when his emotions run high he becomes unable to say anything true - that is, anything meaningful.
$$アイム#keyword$$ Liard is an alias; his real name is Hermal Argo. He was originally a researcher of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and his aptitude led to the $$スフィア$$ absorbing him.
Late in the $$再世戦争$$ he was neutralized by $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ wielding the $$スフィア$$ of the Inquisitive Goat, the natural predator of the $$偽りの黒羊$$, and met his end at the hands of $$ユーサー$$ $$インサラウム$$, ruler of the Holy $$インサラウム$$ Kingdom he had been using.

マーティアルの聖地アレギウムが、キリコ・キュービィーの駆るたった一機\nのＡＴ.en:
The incident in which $$アレギウム$$, the holy land of $$マーティアル$$, had its defense units broken through by a single AT piloted by $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, and its cathedral was attacked.
The cause of the incident was that Cardinal $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$ 'touched' $$キリコ$$, whom $$テオ８世$$ had declared 'the Untouchable', and as a result of this affair the authority of the church collapsed.

全ての事象の過去と未来が記されているとされる概念。\n それにアクセスする事は.en:
A concept said to record the past and future of all phenomena.
Accessing it is said to be equivalent to leaving the material world and obtaining infinity that transcends time.

時空震動によって東京湾の一帯に転移してきた聖天使学園とその周囲地域の\n行政区.en:
The administrative division consisting of $$聖天使学園$$, which was transferred to the Tokyo Bay area by the $$時空震動|lc$$, and its surrounding area.
The chairwoman of $$聖天使学園$$, $$クレア$$, who concluded the negotiations with the federal government, serves as the city's representative.
Its name derives from the mythology of the world they came from.

世界を裏から操る謎多き秘密結社。\n アマルガムとは水銀と他の金属元素との合金.en:
A shadowy secret society with many mysteries, manipulating the world from behind the scenes.
$$アマルガム$$ is the term for an alloy of mercury and other metallic elements, and its executives hold code names corresponding to metallic elements, such as Mr. K (Potassium) and Mr. Fe (Iron).
It is after the $$ウィスパード$$ and the Black Technology sleeping within them, and is hostile to $$ミスリル$$, which aims at their humanitarian protection.

$$アマルガム$$ is the term for an alloy of mercury and other metallic elements, and its executives hold code names corresponding to metallic elements, such as Mr. K (Potassium) and Mr. Fe (Iron).
It is after the $$ウィスパード$$ and the Black Technology sleeping within them, and is hostile to $$ミスリル$$, which aims at their humanitarian protection.
At the time of its founding, its ideal was to be an organization that protects humanity's future from war, but its nature changed amid the turnover of members, and protecting the vested interests of its members became its main purpose.
Its organizational form was a democratic one with no clearly designated leader, but it was later transformed into a dictatorial organization by $$レナード$$, who was advancing his own plans.

並行世界の地球を治めていた聖インサラウム王国の宰相。\n 元は科学技術庁長官で.en:
Prime Minister of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, which ruled the Earth of a parallel world.
She was originally the Director of the Bureau of Science and Technology, and after $$インサラウム$$ was destroyed by the $$破界の王$$, she was appointed Prime Minister amid the chaos and advised Prince $$ユーサー$$ to invade the parallel world.
She devoted her life to the forbidden pursuit of dimensional science, and the fruits of her research, the artificial $$次元獣$$ series, became a major military force in $$インサラウム$$'s invasion of Earth.
In the final battle on Mars in the $$再世戦争$$, she transformed herself into the artificial $$次元獣$$ $$エクサ・アダモン$$ and fought, but was defeated by $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ and met her end.
Her death also brought $$インサラウム$$'s research into dimensional science to a standstill.

高次元エネルギーと、その持ち主を指すプロトデビルンの言葉。\n 過去、プロトデ.en:
A term used by the $$プロトデビルン$$ to refer to high-dimensional energy and its possessor.
In the past, it is said that the one who sealed the $$プロトデビルン$$ on the ice planet was a possessor of this $$アニマスピリチア$$, and its power has properties directly opposite to $$スピリチア$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$'s energy source, dealing them damage.
The $$プロトデビルン$$ regarded $$熱気バサラ$$ of $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ as a threat, believing him to be an $$アニマスピリチア$$.

時空震動を人為的に起こす謎の存在。\n その時空震動に巻き込まれながらも生き残.en:
A mysterious being that artificially causes $$時空震動|lc$$s.
Those who were caught up in that $$時空震動|lc$$ and yet survived develop a phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$', in which both eyes turn red, and fall into a state in which their emotions have died.
Because its figure, smiling amid the light, was even divine, it is called by this name, but its identity and purpose are entirely unknown.

It was later revealed that its identity was $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and it became clear that it had been an attempt to find humans possessing the strong power of life that he desired.

フルネームはアンナロッタ・ストールス。\n サイデリアルに属していた特殊部隊ジ.en:
Her full name is $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$.
Vice commander of $$ジェミニス$$, a special unit that belonged to $$サイデリアル$$.
A calm, composed, and capable commander, she was also a first-rate pilot of mobile weapons, and boasted astonishing combat power by reflecting her own psychokinetic power directly in her piloting.
For the sake of carrying out her missions she was thoroughly ruthless, and if the other party was an enemy, she could even commit acts that could be called cruel and inhuman.
Inwardly, however, she was conflicted about what they were doing, and there was also an aspect of her deliberately acting coldly in order to shake that off.
The last woman of the $$ジェミナイド$$s, the inhabitants of Planet $$ジェミナイ$$.
The partner of $$ジェミニス$$ commander $$ガドライト#pilot$$ in both public and private life, and carrying their child.
The heredity of the $$ジェミナイド$$s is completely matrilineal-dominant, and even when they mate with another race, as long as the mother is a $$ジェミナイド$$, her genes are certain to take priority. Conversely, when there are no women, the $$ジェミナイド$$s cannot pass the genes of their race on to their descendants.
After $$ガドライト#pilot$$ fell, she was executed by $$尸空#pilot$$.

After $$ガドライト#pilot$$ fell, she was executed by $$尸空#pilot$$, but the child in her belly was unharmed, and twin daughters who would come to be named $$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$ were born.

アメリカ軍退役中佐のジョン・ジョージ・コートニーを指す。\n 海兵隊精神にあふ.en:
Refers to $$ジョン・ジョージ・コートニー$$, a retired lieutenant colonel of the U.S. military.
A former soldier brimming with the Marine Corps spirit.
He is an old friend of $$ミスリル$$'s Admiral $$ボーダ$$, and also a huge fan of $$テッサ$$.

サイデリアルに属する特殊部隊。\n 隊長はバルビエル・ザ・ニードル、副隊長はサ.en:
A special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
The captain is $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$ and the vice-captain is $$サルディアス・アクス$$.
Its main forces are the $$アンゲロイＡＮＴ$$ and the $$シャウラス$$.
Its members wear pilot suits like restraints, and on the battlefield they attack enemies with their hatred laid bare.
They are not people of any particular star or of a single race; $$バルビエル$$ personally finds those who harbor hatred, breaks down their reason, and uses them as soldiers.

螺旋力を持つ全ての生物を根絶やしにせんとする存在。\n ニアをメッセンジャーに.en:
A being that seeks to wipe out every lifeform possessing $$螺旋力$$.
Using $$ニア$$ as a $$メッセンジャー$$, it declared that it would bring despair upon humanity and attempted to drop the moon onto the Earth, but the plan was thwarted thanks to the efforts of $$シモン$$ and his friends.
Afterward, it confronted $$シモン$$ and his friends directly in the $$隔絶宇宙$$, but was defeated, and entrusted the future of the universe to them.

天翅族における最強の守護天翅。\n １万２０００年前には、その大いなる力で多く.en:
The strongest guardian winged one of the winged race.
Twelve thousand years ago, $$アポロニアス#keyword$$ hunted many humans with great power and committed every manner of slaughter. But in the midst of battle, $$アポロニアス#keyword$$ met $$セリアン$$, a human woman warrior, and the two came to love each other.
Eventually breaking with the winged race, $$アポロニアス#keyword$$ created the '$$機械天使アクエリオン$$' and fought the winged race together with humans.

１万２０００年前の堕天翅族と神話型アクエリオンを駆る者達の戦いを描い\nた映画.en:
A film depicting the battle 12,000 years ago between the $$堕天翅$$ tribe and those who piloted the $$神話型アクエリオン$$. Based on mythology, it is a love story themed around the love between $$アポロン$$, the reincarnation of a $$堕天翅$$ hero, and $$シルフィ$$.
Note that 'Aqueria' refers to $$アクエリオン$$ itself.
Though the film itself is nothing special, the theme song sung by its lead actress $$アリシア$$, who played $$シルフィ$$, has been highly acclaimed.

聖インサラウム王国を防衛する軍事組織、またはその団員と使用する機動兵\n器を指.en:
Refers to the military organization that defends the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, or to its members together with the mobile weapons they use.
Adhering to a policy of purely defensive warfare, it has fought to protect the citizens from the alien life forms and extraterrestrials that attack $$インサラウム$$, which had unified the Earth of a parallel world.
Its personnel are called knights, and they swear loyalty to the Holy King who rules $$インサラウム$$ and to dedicate their own lives to the Holy King and the people. Their existence is an object of respect for the citizens, and the knights take pride in it.
Currently, under the command of $$マルグリット$$, they are taking part in the settlement group bound for Mars together with the people of $$インサラウム$$.

人類銀河同盟の本拠地となる巨大な移民船で、人類の生存に適した惑星を探\nしてい.en:
A gigantic emigrant ship that serves as the home base of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, searching for a planet suited to human survival.
Military personnel of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ are granted, for 145,000 hours (about 16 years) of military service, the right to apply for limited citizenship and a four-week travel and stay permit at $$アヴァロン$$ (freedom to sleep, freedom to eat and drink, freedom to reproduce).

知的生命体の天敵と言われる生物・物体の総称。\n 遥か過去から全銀河を舞台にバ.en:
A general term for the creatures and objects said to be the natural enemies of intelligent life.
It is said that battles against $$バアル$$ have been waged across the entire galaxy since the distant past, and that they appear in great numbers in response to the rebirth of the universe, which occurs on a cycle of 12,000 years. Some also say that it was beings called 'gods' who fought against $$バアル$$, and that humanity was powerless.
None of this information has been substantiated, either, and the truth of the matter and their total numbers remain shrouded in mystery to this day.

During the fighting, it was learned that they are generated from the 'force that tries to vanish', one of the two great forces that make up the universe, but it is unclear whether that force itself gives rise to $$バアル$$, or whether creatures absorbed by it are $$バアル$$.

マクロス７船団を中心に発生した、人類とプロトデビルンによる一連の戦い。\n プ.en:
A series of battles between humanity and the $$プロトデビルン$$ that broke out centered on the $$マクロス７船団$$.
The fighting began when the $$バロータ軍$$ attacked the $$マクロス７船団$$ in order to gather $$スピリチア$$, the bioenergy of humans, which is food for the $$プロトデビルン$$.
Influenced by the song of $$熱気バサラ$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$ evolved into a species that regenerates $$スピリチア$$ by itself, so the reason for fighting disappeared and the war came to an end. Afterward, the $$プロトデビルン$$ left the Milky Way.

ウドの街が発祥と言われているＡＴによる賭け試合。\n アームパンチのみのレギュ.en:
Betting matches fought with $$ＡＴ$$s, said to have originated in the town of $$ウド$$.
There is a wide variety of rules, from regular games with arm punches only to life-or-death real battles using live ammunition, and the spectators place bets on who wins and loses.

時空震動や次元震で現れた敵対外来種「ビースト」を駆除するハンター。\n 外来種.en:
Hunters who exterminate the hostile alien species called 'Beasts' that appear through spacequakes and dimensional tremors.
An alien species is only classed as a Beast if it disturbs this world's ecosystem. Further, hunters only handle those small in scale and confined to a specific area. On that basis Dimensional Beasts, which are large in scale and appear worldwide, fall outside a $$ビーストハンター$$'s remit.
The Rocky Mountains of North America hold spots where the dimensional boundary is unstable and Beasts appear often, so many professional hunters make their homes nearby.

謎の存在「テンシ」が引き起こす時空震動に巻き込まれながらも生き残った\n者に現.en:
A symptom that appears in those who were caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$ caused by the mysterious being '$$テンシ$$' and yet survived.
Both eyes turn red, and the person falls into a state as if their emotions had died.

A symptom that appears in those who were caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$ caused by the mysterious being '$$テンシ$$' and yet survived.
Both eyes turn red, and the person falls into a state as if their emotions had died.
This is caused by body and mind being overwhelmed by awe and fear after coming into contact with the power of the $$御使い$$.
Those from whom life force has been excessively absorbed by the $$霊子吸収システム$$ also sense the presence of the $$御使い$$, the destination to which that power is sent, and fall into the same symptoms.
In theory, it can be overcome by anyone with enough mental strength to throw off the pressure of the $$御使い$$, but for ordinary humans this is basically impossible.

ＵＣＷを混沌の渦に叩き落としたカイメラの黒幕、ジ・エーデル・ベルナル\nが傀儡.en:
The mind-control technology used by $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, the mastermind of $$カイメラ$$ who plunged the $$ＵＣＷ$$ into a whirlpool of chaos, to control the puppet $$エーデル・ベルナル$$.
By means of specific words, it becomes possible to switch the target's mind into a submission mode and force them to act.
The artificial human $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ had the $$バインドスペル$$ built in at birth, but it can also be applied later in life through a procedure like hypnosis. In that case, to reduce the target's psychological resistance, the target must be made, at least once, to take a stance of accepting commands of their own free will. The automation of that is precisely the mechanism of the $$バインドスペル$$.

大時空震動によって北米大陸に同時に存在する事になった二つの大国、神聖\nブリタ.en:
A great power born from the union of two great nations that the $$大時空震動$$ left occupying the North American continent at the same time: the Holy Britannian Empire and the $$ユニオン$$ ($$ユニオン$$ of Solar Energy and Free Nations).
It boasted the largest force in $$ＡＤＷ$$ until the Earth Federation was founded, and even afterwards those from the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$ carried considerable political weight.

運動能力や思考力、反射神経などを常人の１０倍のスピードで働かせる能力。\n た.en:
The ability to run one's motor skills, thought and reflexes at ten times ordinary human speed.
It lasts only about ten seconds, however, and cannot be used repeatedly.
What triggers the ability is unknown, though touching $$ジェニオン$$'s operating manual is thought to have set it off.

過激さで知られた政治団体。\n 構成員は全員ナチュラルで、「青き清浄なる世界の.en:
A political organization known for its extremism.
Its members are all $$ナチュラル$$s, and under the slogan 'for a blue and pure world', it aims at the exclusion of $$コーディネイター$$s. Among $$ナチュラル$$s there are many who, even without joining $$ブルーコスモス$$, find $$コーディネイター$$s suspect, but that too is a result of the group's manipulation of public consciousness.
Being a political organization is only its public face; behind the scenes it also has the aspect of a secret society that acts as the hands and feet of $$ロゴス$$ in order to bring about the eradication of $$コーディネイター$$s. These plans are advanced by members at the center of the $$地球連合$$ and its military.
After leader $$ムルタ・アズラエル$$ died in the second Battle of $$ヤキン・ドゥーエ$$ in C.E. 71, it lay low for a time. But once $$ロード・ジブリール$$ took over as the new leader, it has been moving the $$大西洋連邦$$ and the media to steer public opinion and lead the $$地球連合$$ and the $$プラント$$ into war once more.
However, $$デュランダル$$'s exposure destroyed the organization's upper ranks along with $$ロゴス$$, and its activities were forced into drastic decline.

ＡＤＷの破界事変の中盤、リモネシア共和国で発生した時空震動。\n アイム・ライ.en:
A spacequake that occurred in the Republic of $$リモネシア$$ in the middle of the $$破界事変$$ in the $$ＡＤＷ$$.
It was an artificial spacequake caused with an enormous amount of $$ＤＥＣ$$ under the guidance of $$アイム・ライアード$$, and the $$破界の王$$ and the forces under him were transferred to the $$ＡＤＷ$$ from a parallel world.
This spacetime disaster dealt devastating damage to the Republic of $$リモネシア$$, and the world was also thrown into war by $$ガイオウ$$, the $$破界の王$$, and the $$新帝国インペリウム$$.

リ・ブラスタに搭載されたスフィア「揺れる天秤」の反作用から、クロウの\n自我を.en:
A system developed by $$トライア$$ to protect the ego of $$クロウ$$ from the backlash of the $$スフィア$$ '$$揺れる天秤$$' mounted on the $$リ・ブラスタ$$.
$$ＣＤＳ$$ is short for 'Coin Drop System'.
When $$クロウ$$ is about to be taken over by the strong will needed to draw out the $$揺れる天秤$$, the sound of the coins he loves rings out, in order to hold that consciousness in place below the level of awareness.
That allows $$クロウ$$ to keep hold of his ego by the barest margin while drawing out the power of the $$スフィア$$.
Because real sound is used in order to value realism, actual expenses are incurred whenever the system activates. As a result, $$クロウ$$ came to bear the fate of being tied down to something other than the $$スフィア$$.

フルネームはシュラン・オペル。\n ＵＣＷの新地球連邦軍の軍人。\n エーデル.en:
Full name: $$シュラン・オペル$$.
A soldier of the New Earth Federation Forces of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Captain of the 2nd Squad of $$カイメラ$$, which is under $$エーデル$$'s direct command, with the rank of captain.
He shows his true worth in rear-area duties such as maintaining public order and information warfare.
He takes pleasure in watching situations fall into confusion because of his own schemes, and has a flamboyantly wicked side that openly admits it.
Calm and composed, and never breaking a cool attitude at any time, he gives others a cold impression, but that is a pose to hide inner anxiety.
He wished to live by emotion, and for that reason both loathed and was strongly drawn to the impulsive $$レーベン$$.
Defeated in the decisive battle with $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ set at the central station of the $$ＵＮ$$, he met his final moments shouting the name of $$レーベン$$.

それぞれの並行世界に存在し、人類の歴史を影から操ってきた組織の総称。\n その.en:
A general term for the organizations that exist in each parallel world and have manipulated the history of humanity from the shadows.
Their members are hereditary, and there exist a supreme authority called the $$キング$$ and a decision-making body called the Council of Thirteen.
There are two opposing groups, called the Conservatives and the Reformists, who call themselves 'those who monitor humanity's evolution' and 'those who watch over humanity's evolution' respectively.
Of these, the Conservatives are the mainstream and hold strong influence over political and financial circles and the military. The oppression of Spacenoids in each parallel world was carried out on their orders.
In the $$時獄戦役$$, they cooperated with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ of $$ジェミニス$$ and acted according to his instructions.

A general term for the organizations that exist in each parallel world and have manipulated the history of humanity from the shadows.
Their members are hereditary, and there exist a supreme authority called the $$キング$$ and a decision-making body called the Council of Thirteen.
There are two opposing groups, called the Conservatives and the Reformists, who call themselves 'those who monitor humanity's evolution' and 'those who watch over humanity's evolution' respectively.
Of these, the Conservatives are the mainstream and hold strong influence over political and financial circles and the military. The oppression of Spacenoids in each parallel world was carried out on their orders.
In the $$時獄戦役$$, they cooperated with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ of $$ジェミニス$$ and acted according to his instructions.
The founding of $$クロノ$$ was triggered by humanity's landing on the surface of the Moon. Those who submitted to the message of the $$御使い$$ left behind there, 'Humanity is a species that is not permitted to evolve', and to that power have since managed the history of humanity... or, in other words, its evolution... under their direction.
Those who opposed this way of being founded the Reformists from within, but they were overwhelmingly inferior in strength, and those who tried to make the managers of humanity public were also silenced by means such as assassination.
After the invasion of $$蒼の地球$$ by $$サイデリアル$$, it became entirely a subordinate organization of the $$新地球皇国$$, but after its existence was made public and the Empire was overthrown, it gradually lost its power, fading away of its own accord.

受精卵の段階で、高度な知性と頑健な肉体を持つように遺伝子を調整されて\n産まれ.en:
A general term for humans born from embryos whose genes were adjusted at the fertilized egg stage so that they would have advanced intelligence and robust bodies. Their existence came to light through the confession of $$ジョージ・グレン$$, the $$ファーストコーディネイター$$, which was broadcast to the entire world in C.E. 15.
They acquire many excellent qualities, both physical and mental, from birth. However, whether those abilities blossom depends on the environment in which they grow up.
Most $$コーディネイター$$s live in the $$プラント$$, but there are exceptional places where they coexist with $$ナチュラル$$s (ordinary humans who have not undergone genetic adjustment), such as neutral nations like $$オーブ$$ and lunar cities.
Those born to $$ナチュラル$$ parents through genetic adjustment are called 'First-Generation $$コーディネイター$$s', and children born between $$コーディネイター$$s are called 'Second-Generation $$コーディネイター$$s'.
However, the birth rate is declining year by year, and this has become a major problem in $$コーディネイター$$ society.

ガイゾック星人に造られたコンピューター。\n 悪い考えに満ちた生き物を抹殺する.en:
A computer built by the $$ガイゾック$$ aliens.
It was programmed to exterminate living things filled with evil thoughts, and after destroying $$ビアル星$$, the homeland of the ancestors of the $$神ファミリー$$, it began the extermination of Earthlings after a sleep of 200 years.

テロリストグループ「Ａ２１」によってお台場で引き起こされた事件。\n ラムダ・.en:
An incident caused in $$お台場$$ by the terrorist group '$$Ａ２１$$'.
The giant AS '$$ベヘモス$$', equipped with a Lambda Driver, carried out acts of destruction, but the $$ベヘモス$$ was defeated by the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$ piloted by $$宗介$$, and $$Ａ２１$$ was suppressed.
During this battle, $$テッサ$$ and $$かなめ$$ shared their feelings, and $$テッサ$$ declared war in the battle of love over $$宗介$$.

地球人類とゼントラーディとの間で繰り広げられた星間戦争。\n 戦いの中、ゼント.en:
An interstellar war fought between Earth's humanity and the $$ゼントラーディ$$.
During the fighting, part of the $$ゼントラーディ$$ camp came into contact with Earth's culture, beginning with the songs of $$リン・ミンメイ$$, and lost the will to fight from culture shock.
When the $$ゼントラーディ$$'s $$ブリタイ$$ fleet then formed an alliance with the Earthlings, the $$ゼントラーディ$$ side's command fell into disorder, and it finally became a war between $$ボドルザー$$, who tried to destroy culture, and those who opposed him.
Through the '$$ミンメイ・アタック$$', an enemy-confusion operation using $$リン・ミンメイ$$'s songs, the war ended in victory for the Earth side, and the Earthlings and the $$ゼントラーディ$$ came to walk the path of coexistence.
Stories based on this great war have been made into visual works several times, in the $$マクロス７船団$$ and elsewhere, and $$リン・ミンメイ$$, who led the war to its end, has become a legendary idol singer as a great figure in history.

ある世界で発生した巨大な時空震動。\n その衝撃により全ての並行世界を隔てる壁.en:
An enormous spacequake that occurred in a certain world.
Its shock collapsed the walls separating every parallel world, and a great many multiverses came into being.
It is held to have been caused by the runaway of a weapon called a $$時空震動弾$$, though much about the bomb's developer and the origin of the technology remains a mystery.
Those present at the site of the $$大時空震動$$ are called singularities, and are considered indispensable to the $$時空修復$$ that would reconstitute the multiverse.

新国連が、蘇った堕天翅族に対抗するために設立した特殊機関。\n 正式名は「地球.en:
A special agency established by the $$新国連$$ to counter the resurrected $$堕天翅$$ tribe.
Its official name is the 'Earth Revitalization Organization DEAVA (Division of EArth Vitalization Advancement)'.
$$不動ＧＥＮ#pilot$$ serves as commander, and within the base is the '$$エレメントスクール$$', which trains $$エレメント$$s and $$エレメント$$ candidates.
It operated $$アクエリオン$$ and fought the $$堕天翅$$ tribe.

並行世界間を行き来する企業「ＤＥＭ（Ｄｉｍｅｎｓｉｏｎ Ｅｘｔｒａ\nＭｅｒｃ.en:
Short for '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Extra Merchant) Corporation', a company that travels between parallel worlds.
It also refers to that corporation's mobile weapon series, '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Energy Machinery)'.
$$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation's employees call themselves dimensional merchants and take pride in doing business across a variety of parallel worlds.
$$ＡＧ$$ is one of their agent robots, but is currently cut off, unable to contact head office. With $$時の牢獄$$ destroyed, a change in that situation was hoped for, but contact remains impossible, and it is surmised that some kind of trouble has occurred.

Short for '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Extra Merchant) Corporation', a company that travels between parallel worlds.
It also refers to that corporation's mobile weapon series, '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Energy Machinery)'.
$$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation's employees call themselves dimensional merchants and take pride in doing business across a variety of parallel worlds.
$$ＡＧ$$ is one of their agent robots, but is currently cut off, unable to contact head office. With $$時の牢獄$$ destroyed, a change in that situation was hoped for, but contact remained impossible, and it was surmised that some kind of trouble had occurred.
Later, through the confession of $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$, who is also $$ＡＧ$$, it came to light that its existence was a dummy.

プラント最高評議会議長ギルバート・デュランダルにより提唱された社会シ\nステム.en:
A concept for a social system proposed by $$ギルバート・デュランダル$$, Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.
It aims at efficient management of society by analyzing genes to investigate each person's aptitudes and abilities and, based on the results, placing each individual in the occupation or post suited to their abilities.
With destiny decided, anxiety about the future is resolved, but opposition movements arose on the grounds that it would produce a closed society that robbed people of free will. $$デュランダル$$ tried to suppress them by force, and this led to war.
$$デュランダル$$ was struck down by a faction that took $$ラクス・クライン$$ as its banner, and the plan came to a halt.

月面に建造された、かつての地球連邦の重要拠点。\n 太陽光発電で稼働する無人施.en:
A former key facility of the Earth Federation, built on the surface of the Moon.
An unmanned facility that runs on solar power generation, it can in theory keep supplying inexhaustible, massive energy.
Because it controls the microwave transmission facility needed to fire the $$サテライトキャノン$$, taking control of $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$ means taking control of the $$サテライトキャノン$$, but the surroundings of the facility are protected by powerful $$ビットＭＳ$$, which refuse intruders from outside.
In reality, it is the $$ファーストニュータイプ$$, broken down genetically at the nano level and turned into a biological system. The will of the $$ファーストニュータイプ$$ built into it remained, and it demonstrated abilities such as sensing the presence of other $$ニュータイプ$$s and moving the $$ビットＭＳ$$ through the $$フラッシュシステム$$.
It told the visiting $$ティファ$$ the meaning of $$ニュータイプ$$, entrusted the future to the people, and went to sleep.

プラント最高評議会議長。\n 前議長パトリック・ザラとは異なり、ナチュラルとの.en:
Chairman of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.
Unlike his predecessor $$パトリック・ザラ$$, he is a moderate who sought a road to coexistence and peace with $$ナチュラル$$s. During the $$ユニウスセブン$$ drop and the fighting with the $$地球連合$$ that followed, he consistently made calm, accurate judgments and showed excellent leadership.
He is also an authority on genetic research, and it is thought that it was through that work that he came to know $$ラウ・ル・クルーゼ$$ and $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$. There are also signs that he had anticipated from the start that $$シン$$ would manifest the SEED.
He set up $$ミーア・キャンベル$$ as a stand-in for $$ラクス・クライン$$ in an attempt to raise the fighting spirit of all of the $$プラント$$. But it came to light that behind the scenes he had plotted the assassination of $$ラクス$$ herself, and this earned him the distrust of $$キラ$$ and the others.
His ultimate aim was to build a managed society controlling humanity at the genetic level, which he called the '$$デスティニープラン$$'. After annihilating $$ロゴス$$, he declared the introduction and implementation of the plan to the world, only to be stopped by $$キラ$$ and the others, who refused a world where evolution would halt.
At the last he was shot by $$レイ#pt136$$, whom he had trusted like a son. He closed his life in the arms of $$タリア$$, who had once been his lover and toward whom he had continued to hold feelings even after they parted.

アークセイバーの一般団員が搭乗する人型機動兵器。全長２５．９ｍ。\n ナイトオ.en:
A humanoid mobile weapon piloted by rank-and-file members of the $$アークセイバー$$. Total length 25.9 m.
A mass-produced, scaled-down version of the $$ナイトオブナイツ$$' $$ディアムド$$, it excels in versatility.
This unit is also equipped with the $$次元力$$ control system '$$Ｄエクストラクター$$', and its combat power is markedly improved compared with the models used before the onslaught of the King of Destruction.
Normally, Dim-series units are given to the elite forces that form the core of military strength, but the $$アークセイバー$$, whose forces ran short after the destruction of $$インサラウム$$, has made this expensive unit its main force to raise pilot survivability. This was on the instruction of $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$, who considered human life the greatest asset.
At present, keeping them is permitted in the name of preserving culture, but the members of the $$アークセイバー$$ are prepared to activate the $$ディム・サー$$s if a fight to protect their own pride should occur.

次元力は全宇宙に普遍的に存在するエネルギーであるが、天の川銀河の太陽\n系第３.en:
$$次元力$$ is an energy that exists universally throughout the entire universe, but the third planet of the Solar System in the Milky Way galaxy, Earth, is said to be the optimal place to draw it out.
The twelve constellations of the zodiac are made up of those stars, among the stars that are masses of $$次元力$$, that have especially strong energy, and the Earth is positioned to gather $$次元力$$ from them. That $$次元力$$ is stored throughout the Earth and becomes the power that nourishes the land.
For that reason, those who seek to use $$次元力$$ as their own power try to take the Earth into their hands.

トップレスが物理法則を超越し、運動性能や情報、空間を書き換える能力。\n バス.en:
The ability of the $$トップレス$$ to transcend the laws of physics and rewrite motion performance, information, and space.
It is also used for the power and attacks of the $$バスターマシン$$, and causes various phenomena depending on the characteristics of the machine and the aptitude of the $$トップレス$$.

アクエリオンを操縦するために選ばれた、特殊能力に目覚めた者達。\n 彼らが持つ.en:
Those who awakened special abilities and were chosen to pilot $$アクエリオン$$.
The special power they possess is called $$エレメント$$ ability, and without this ability, one cannot even board a $$ベクターマシン$$, let alone combine into $$アクエリオン$$.
Note that the ability differs from one $$エレメント$$ to the next.

ＡＤＷの元国連の平和維持理事会の代表で、現在は地球連邦軍総司令官。\n 平和維.en:
In the $$ＡＤＷ$$, a representative of the Peacekeeping Council of the former $$国連$$, and currently Supreme Commander of the Earth Federation Forces.
When he was representative of the Peacekeeping Council, he formed a special international rescue team that acted beyond the bounds of organization and position for the peace and happiness of all humanity.
He possesses a strong will that does not hesitate at immediate sacrifice, but voices of suspicion are also being raised over his forceful methods and his unreadable true intentions.
Also, though its truth is unconfirmed, records remain suggesting he has lived for over 200 years, and there are many mysteries surrounding him.
His true identity was one of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, those who touched $$クロノエイチ$$.
In order to entrust humanity's future to those who would follow, he gave up his life in the closing stages of the $$再世戦争$$.

外宇宙から飛来した金属生命体。\n 名称は「Ｅｘｔｒａｔｅｒｒｅｓｔｒｉａｌ.en:
A metallic life form that came flying in from outer space.
The name is the initials of 'Extraterrestrial Livingmetal Shapeshifter' (in Japanese, 'extraterrestrial mutable metallic body').
It has various abilities, such as operating machines, latching onto humans and turning them into metal, and mimicking the people, weapons, and so on that it has invaded.
It is also drawn to $$脳量子波$$.
It is a kind of colonial organism, and its individual members have no ego.

A metallic life form that came flying in from outer space.
The name is the initials of 'Extraterrestrial Livingmetal Shapeshifter' (in Japanese, 'extraterrestrial mutable metallic body').
It has various abilities, such as operating machines, latching onto humans and turning them into metal, and mimicking the people, weapons, and so on that it has invaded.
It is also drawn to $$脳量子波$$.
It is a kind of colonial organism, and its individual members have no ego.
Through dialogue with $$刹那$$, it came to understand that the humanity of Earth is founded on the 'individual', and it gathered together into one giant flower and ended the battle.
Afterward, the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ walked the path of coexistence with humanity and became a great force in Earth humanity's advance into outer space.

プロトカルチャーが造り上げた生体兵器群。\n 同じくプロトカルチャーによって造.en:
A group of biological weapons built by the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
They were more powerful than the giant combat soldiers '$$ゼントラーディ$$', which the $$プロトカルチャー$$ had also created, but during test operation, energy life forms possessing will that appeared from the $$サブ・ユニバース$$ took possession of them, turning them into the '$$プロトデビルン$$' and making them bare their fangs at the $$プロトカルチャー$$.

後に黒歴史と呼ばれる事となった世界において、地球環境の回復を目的とし\nて構築.en:
Refers to a system built with the aim of restoring the Earth's environment in the world that later came to be called $$黒歴史$$, or to the unmanned units that act under the management of that system.
It was prepared after the wars of $$黒歴史$$ to restore the devastated environment and to eliminate anything that stood in the way of that. However, after the end of the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$, it came to recognize the existence of humanity as a target for elimination and began to act.
When $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ defeated its master system, all the systems stopped.

クダン・ミラが開発したラムダ・ドライバ観測機器。\n ＡＳに装備され、使用時に.en:
A Lambda Driver observation device developed by $$クダン・ミラ$$.
It is mounted on AS units, and when it is used, the external monitor takes on a state as if a green filter had been applied, and the effective range and strength of Lambda Drivers are displayed in shades of color.
With this, the movements of enemy units equipped with Lambda Drivers can be checked, and by using tactics such as attacking from a distance or direction the enemy's attention is not directed toward, it became possible to defeat them even in an M9.

父と姉を時空震動によって失った事件を指す。\n その時空震動で生き残った彼は「.en:
Refers to the incident in which he lost his father and older sister to a spacequake.
Having survived that spacequake, he developed '$$血塗られた眼$$' and began to pursue the being '$$テンシ$$' thought to have caused it.

Refers to the incident in which he lost his father and older sister to a spacequake.
Having survived that spacequake, he developed '$$血塗られた眼$$' and began to pursue the being '$$テンシ$$' thought to have caused it.
It was later revealed that the true identity of that $$テンシ$$ had been $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.

トップレス能力を持つ少年少女が所属する組織。\n トップレスの人権を守ると同時.en:
An organization to which boys and girls with $$トップレス$$ ability belong.
Alongside protecting the human rights of the $$トップレス$$, it holds a powerful voice and budget by virtue of monopolizing the $$バスターマシン$$, the trump card against $$宇宙怪獣$$, and possesses combat strength on par with the $$宇宙軍$$.
Garrison bases exist throughout the Solar System, beginning with the '$$メガネビュラ$$' base on Mars.
In order to prevent the $$トップレス$$, who are children, from being exploited by adults, it maintains a system in which adult intervention is excluded.

ジャミルがキャプテンを務めるアルプス級陸上戦艦。\n 形式上は「陸上戦艦」とな.en:
The Alps-class land battleship with $$ジャミル$$ serving as captain.
Although formally a 'land battleship', it can also travel over water by hovering, so its range of action is wide.
It can carry up to six mobile suits, and its main complement was the $$ガンダムＸ$$, the $$ガンダムエアマスター$$ and the $$ガンダムレオパルド$$.
It was also the living space of pilots such as $$ガロード$$ and the others, and when $$ロアビィ$$ came to be exclusively employed by $$フリーデン$$, he had set up a relaxation room at his own expense to make the journey comfortable.
Although it was heavily damaged in the battle when $$ガロード$$ was sent off into space, the space battleship that $$ジャミル$$ and the others later obtained was given the name '$$フリーデン$$' once again.

ニーナがシュナイゼル配下の研究チーム、インヴォーグと共に開発した大量\n破壊兵.en:
A weapon of mass destruction that $$ニーナ$$ developed together with $$インヴォーグ$$, a research team under $$シュナイゼル$$.
The name is short for 'Field Limitary Effective Implosion Armament'.
It makes a certain range of space vanish completely, air included, but produces no secondary effects such as radiation.
Also, an anti-$$フレイヤ$$ weapon, the '$$フレイヤ・エリミネーター$$', was developed by $$ニーナ$$ herself, the developer.

特殊機関「地球再生機構ディーバ」のアクエリオン運用部隊司令官。エレメ\nントス.en:
Commander of the $$アクエリオン$$ operations unit of the special agency 'Earth Regeneration Organization $$ディーバ$$'. He also serves as an instructor at the $$エレメント$$ School. Age unknown.
Because he appears out of nowhere and turns up anywhere, he bears the nickname 'Magician of Divine Speed'. He has mastered a broad and deep range of skills, from conjuring-style tricks, such as producing arrows from nowhere or suddenly enlarging a sheet of paper, to astonishing abilities, such as reading people's minds, calling a wild hawk with a single finger, or reading a person's character and tastes just from their footprints.
Nothing at all is known of his past career apart from his having been a member of the $$アクエリオン$$ excavation expedition. He is a person of many mysteries, whose way of becoming commander is not even known, yet whose words are strangely persuasive. Always giving the $$エレメント$$s hints for getting through difficulties, he leads them to victory.

フルネームはガドライト・メオンサム。\n サイデリアルに属する特殊部隊ジェミニ.en:
His full name is $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.
Commander of $$ジェミニス$$, a special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
He was formerly the Reactor of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, and piloted $$ジェミニア#robot$$, the strongest mobile weapon on Planet $$ジェミナイ$$.
He is also the strongest warrior among the $$ジェミナイド$$s, and like the other $$ジェミニス$$ members he fights by channeling psychokinetic power directly into his unit's controls, though his own strength is on an entirely different level even within $$ジェミニス$$.
Using the $$スフィア$$'s power, he can reverse the opposing emotions that sleep within human hearts, and used this power to sow chaos across the $$地球圏$$.
He had originally been sent to Earth as a watcher over $$時の牢獄$$, but seeing his home planet $$ジェミナイ$$ destroyed by persons unknown, he came to bitterly envy Earth's continued existence, protected as it was from the fundamental calamity even with no future of its own. As a result, he abandoned his original duty and now moves his $$ジェミニス$$ subordinates toward the opposite goal: the annihilation of Earth's humanity.
He loves idleness and drink, and normally passes his tedious, aimless days at a bar, watching the chaos he himself unleashed upon the world. His second-in-command $$アンナロッタ$$ scolds him often for his slovenly ways, but he has not the slightest intention of changing. In truth, though, this was all a way of covering up the powerful anger inside him, and the resignation of having nowhere to direct it, and it was this very duality that powered the $$いがみ合う双子$$, keyed to opposing emotions.
As for his level of awakening as a $$スフィア・リアクター$$, he calls himself a Third Stage, surpassing even $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$ and $$アイム・ライアード$$.
In the end, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ threw the balance of his opposing emotions into disarray, and the $$スフィア$$ was seized from him by $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, bringing about his defeat.

プロジェクト・ウズメによって別次元より現れた謎の破壊魔。\n 並行世界の地球の.en:
A mysterious agent of destruction who appeared from another dimension through $$プロジェクト・ウズメ$$.
He destroyed the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$ on a parallel-world Earth, and there met $$アイム・ライアード$$. In $$インサラウム$$ he was called the $$破界の王$$, but after the transfer, he began calling himself $$ガイオウ$$ at $$カルロス・アクシオン$$ Jr.'s suggestion.
He had lost his memory, forgetting his real name, origin, and purpose entirely, but driven by the one sense of mission that remained, he sought out strong opponents and spread battle across the world. In the course of those battles he gradually regained his memories, and on the $$陰月$$ he fully awakened to his true mission, though he refused to speak of it.
His true identity is a being known as a $$次元将$$, whose mission is to organize an army of $$次元獣$$s in order to fight some unknown enemy. Even while harboring doubts about his own existence and mission, he devoted his life to battle, living and fighting to the very end as his soul commanded.
His favorite foods are fast food in general, especially hot dogs.

He destroyed the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$ on a parallel-world Earth, and there met $$アイム・ライアード$$. In $$インサラウム$$ he was called the $$破界の王$$, but after the transfer, he began calling himself $$ガイオウ$$ at $$カルロス・アクシオン$$ Jr.'s suggestion.

His favorite foods are fast food in general, especially hot dogs.
Later, his true name, '$$ヴァイシュラバ$$', came to light.

第５１次超長距離移民船団。\n 「銀河の妖精」として知られるシェリル・ノームの.en:
The 51st super long-range emigrant fleet.
The home of $$シェリル・ノーム$$, known as the '$$銀河の妖精$$'.
Like the $$マクロス・フロンティア船団$$, it is an emigrant fleet heading for a new land, sponsored by a private company, the '$$ゼネラルギャラクシー社$$'.
Its technological strength is among the top in the entire galaxy, and it developed technologies that make humans semi-mechanical, such as $$インプラント|lc$$s and cybernetics. Citizens who have undergone $$インプラント|lc$$ conversion live in an environment where reality and the virtual overlap.
On the other hand, it is a harsh living environment for flesh-and-blood humans who have not been implanted, and because of the social system and other factors slums also exist, presenting a distinctive aspect not seen in the other fleets.

Like the $$マクロス・フロンティア船団$$, it is an emigrant fleet heading for a new land, sponsored by a private company, the '$$ゼネラルギャラクシー社$$'.

Although it was devastated by a $$バジュラ$$ attack, a device housing the bodies of the fleet's executives, together with operatives, infiltrated the $$フロンティア船団$$ and worked behind the scenes.

コード所持者によって授けられる謎の力。\n 所有者によって内容は異なるため、そ.en:
A mysterious power granted by a holder of a Code.
Its nature differs with the bearer, so the abilities vary widely.
$$ルルーシュ$$'s $$ギアス$$ is the 'power of absolute obedience', letting him force a command on anyone whose eyes he meets. Gaps in memory are seen around the moment a $$ギアス$$ is cast and while it is active. The ability can be used on any one person only once.
A $$ギアス$$ grows stronger the more it is used, and eventually enters a range the bearer cannot control. Past that point the $$ギアス$$ sigil appears in both eyes, and a bearer in that state can inherit a Code from its holder.

ムーンレィスが住まう月面都市。\n 月の首都であり、王宮である「白の宮殿」、多.en:
A lunar city where the $$ムーンレィス$$ live.
As the capital of the Moon, it has the '$$白の宮殿$$', the royal palace, and the '$$冬の宮殿$$', where many people sleep in cold sleep.
It is guarded by $$ギム・ギンガナム$$, Commander-in-Chief of the Orbital Fleet, and $$ゲンガナム$$ was built by his grandfather.

早乙女博士の娘。\n 父である早乙女博士が目の前で殺害されたのを目の当たりにし.en:
Professor $$早乙女$$'s daughter.
Having witnessed her father, Professor $$早乙女$$, being murdered right before her eyes, she had closed her heart.
After the world was contaminated by $$ゲッター線$$, she was given the name '$$渓$$' to protect her from the people who hated Professor $$早乙女$$, and was raised as $$弁慶$$'s daughter.

宇宙から降り注ぐ謎の宇宙線。\n 早乙女博士が発見し、採取に成功した。\n そ.en:
A mysterious cosmic ray that pours down from space.
Dr. $$早乙女$$ discovered it and succeeded in collecting it.
Many of its details remain unknown at present, but from the words of $$コーウェン$$ and $$スティンガー$$ it came to light that the $$インベーダー#robot$$ seek $$ゲッター線$$ in order to evolve.

プラント最高評議会議長ギルバート・デュランダルの愛称。\n レイ・ザ・バレルに.en:
The nickname of $$プラント$$ Supreme Council Chairman $$ギルバート・デュランダル$$.
$$レイ・ザ・バレル$$ is the one who calls him by it.

フルネームはグレイス・オコナー。\n かつてのシェリルのマネージャーであり、常.en:
Her full name is $$グレイス・オコナー$$.
She was formerly $$シェリル$$'s manager, a woman of consummate skill who always wore a composed smile and effortlessly handled everything from scheduling to babysitting $$シェリル$$.
Her body has been fitted with cybernetic '$$インプラント|lc$$s' that are illegal within the $$フロンティア船団$$, granting her functions such as the ability to hack into network lines.

ロボット帝国のガバール星で使用されている金属で、地球上には存在しない。\n ト.en:
A metal used on Planet Gabar in the $$ロボット帝国$$, which does not exist on Earth.
It is used as the armor material for $$トライダーＧ７$$.

地球連邦軍の月面駐留軍戦技研究班。\n 新型機の評価試験やシェイクダウンを目的.en:
The combat technique research team of the Earth Federation Forces' lunar garrison.
It was set up for the purposes of evaluation testing and shakedown of new-model units.
Its main duties at present are testing toward the formal mass production of the all-domain general-purpose armament system '$$ガナリー・カーバー$$' and the $$バルゴラ$$ that operates it, and building the combat pattern that uses them, called '$$ＧＳコンバット・アクション$$'.
The captain is Captain $$デンゼル・ハマー$$, and the members are First Lieutenant $$トビー・ワトソン$$ and Second Lieutenant $$セツコ・オハラ$$.

勝平と対立していた不良集団、香月組のメンバー。\n 香月らとの疎開中にガイゾッ.en:
A member of the $$香月$$ Gang, a delinquent group that had been at odds with $$勝平$$.
Captured by $$ガイゾック$$ during an evacuation with $$香月$$ and the others, $$浜本$$ was turned into a human bomb without knowing it. Trying to die in a place where he would cause no trouble to those around him, he broke down in panic, unable to bear the fear of dying alone. Held down by others who had likewise become human bombs, he screamed for help as he died in the explosion.

サイデリアルに属する特殊部隊。\n 隊長はエルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス、副.en:
A special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
The commander is $$エルーナルーナ・バーンストラウス$$, and the vice commander is $$ダバラーン・タウ$$.
Its main forces are the $$アンゲロイＨＩＡ$$ and the $$アルデバル$$.
Originally a fighting group that wandered the galaxy, active as pirates or mercenaries, it was incorporated into $$サイデリアル$$ after the death in battle of the previous chief, $$エルーナルーナ$$'s father.
The members hold that life is to be found only amid gunfire, and under $$エルーナルーナ$$'s command they cheerfully enjoy battle.

人類銀河同盟が、種の存続をかけて長きに渡って戦争を続けている宇宙生命\n体。\.en:
A space life form that the $$人類銀河同盟$$ has been at war with for a long time, staking the survival of its species.
There are various variants, such as ammonite-type, ship-type and attack-type, but their ecology and so on are shrouded in mystery.
Through advanced swarm behavior they possess formidable offensive power, but they do not appear to possess anything like a civilization.

人類銀河同盟が、種の存続をかけて長きに渡って戦争を続けている宇宙生命体。\n ア.en:
A space life form that the $$人類銀河同盟$$ has been at war with for a long time, staking the survival of its species.
There are various variants, such as ammonite-type, ship-type and attack-type, but their ecology and so on are shrouded in mystery.
Through advanced swarm behavior they possess formidable offensive power, but they do not appear to possess anything like a civilization.
Their true identity is humanity that evolved, through artificial procedures, to withstand harsh environments.
However, their forms are already far removed from human, and they have become a swarm of bioweapons specialized for survival, having cast aside even ethics, humanitarianism, culture and sensibility.

Ａ．Ｃ．１７５年に暗殺されたコロニーの伝説的指導者。\n 非暴力を標榜する活動.en:
The legendary leader of the colonies, who was assassinated in A.C. 175.
An activist who advocated nonviolence and had been negotiating with the Alliance to gain autonomy for the colonies, but was assassinated because their existence was regarded as dangerous.

地球から遥かに離れた位置に存在するコロニー「アヴァロン」を本拠地とす\nる、ヒ.en:
An organization dedicated to annihilating the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, headquartered in the colony '$$アヴァロン$$', which is located far from Earth.
It has no such things as culture or family, and has a social structure that pursues thoroughgoing rationality and efficiency.

An organization dedicated to annihilating the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, headquartered in the colony '$$アヴァロン$$', which is located far from Earth.
It has no such things as culture or family, and has a social structure that pursues thoroughgoing rationality and efficiency.
Its ancestors were humans who set out from an Earth whose environment had changed drastically, and it had been in a position of opposition, since the time on Earth, to the organization '$$イボルバー$$', which tried to adapt to outer space by modifying humans... in other words, to the ancestors of the '$$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$'.

人体改造に関する技術。\n ギャラクシー船団では市民レベルでも広く導入されてお.en:
Technology related to modification of the human body.
In the $$ギャラクシー船団$$ it is widely adopted even at the citizen level, and its range is broad, from cyborgization of the skeleton, muscles and so on to technology for handling audiovisual data through brain implant devices.
In the $$フロンティア船団$$ and others, except for medical purposes, it is in principle illegal.

正式な名称は聖インサラウム王国。\n 並行世界の地球を統一していた絶対君主制の.en:
Its official name is the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$.
An absolute monarchy that once unified the Earth of a parallel world, with a history of roughly 2,000 years.
Sovereignty rests with the Holy King, its ruler, but a parliament also exists, and policy is carried out in the form of the Holy King approving its decisions.
Its defense organization, the $$アークセイバー$$, adhered to a policy of purely defensive warfare and had protected humanity from alien life forms and extraterrestrials, but it was defeated by the $$破界の王$$, and $$インサラウム$$ was destroyed.
Under the command of $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$, it invaded the $$ＡＤＷ$$, but with the death of $$ユーサー$$ it was defeated by the Earth Federation.
The surviving members of the $$アークセイバー$$ and the citizens were permitted to join the Earth Federation and came to take part in the settlement group bound for Mars.

私設武装組織ソレスタルビーイングの創設者。\n 記録では実在していたのは２００.en:
Founder of the private armed organization $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.
According to the records, a figure of the past who actually lived more than 200 years ago.
He was a genius scientist who, 200 years earlier, had completed technologies such as the $$ＧＮドライヴ$$ and $$ヴェーダ$$, which were said to be decades ahead of their time even as of 2307.
In a message video sent to the media of the entire world after $$刹那$$ and the others carried out their first armed intervention, he declared that armed intervention would be carried out in order to eradicate war.
He had been in cold sleep on the far side of the Moon together with the main body of $$ヴェーダ$$, but was discovered by the ambitious $$アレハンドロ$$ and shot dead.
His true purpose lay in 'unifying the will of humanity toward expansion into space and transforming humanity in preparation for the "$$来たるべき対話$$"', and to that end in guiding the appearance of $$イノベイター$$s.

ジェミニス隊長のガドライトが搭乗していた機動兵器。\n 「いがみ合う双子」のス.en:
The mobile weapon piloted by $$ガドライト#pilot$$, captain of $$ジェミニス$$.
It carried the $$スフィア$$ of the '$$いがみ合う双子$$'.
It was a unit developed for $$ガドライト#pilot$$, the strongest pilot on the planet $$ジェミナイ$$, and the finest technology of $$ジェミナイ$$ was gathered into it. The $$スフィア$$ mounted at that time was initially still under analysis, but when $$ガドライト#pilot$$ awakened as a Reactor, its various functions were elucidated, and $$ジェミニア#robot$$ was completed.
Its basic design follows $$ディオスク$$, and psychokinetic control, armament using light particles, and high close-combat performance are common to both. However, combining these with $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s powerful psychokinesis and outstanding piloting skill, and further with the $$スフィア$$'s $$次元力$$, produces overwhelming combat power. By calculation, that combat power rivaled a battalion made up of $$ディオスク$$.
The $$スフィア$$'s control over phenomena was concentrated on improving this unit's mobility and maneuverability and on landing sure blows against enemies, so it gives a plain impression compared with other units equipped with a $$スフィア$$, but all of it was unified under the concept of delivering a killing blow, and it produced overwhelming offensive power that even surpassed other units equipped with a $$スフィア$$.
To the $$ジェミナイド$$s it was a symbol of their home planet's prosperity, and had become something beyond a mere mobile weapon, so $$ジェミニス$$ loathed $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, which closely resembles it.
Together with $$ジェミニス$$ it was ever victorious and undefeated, but because of its single defeat, the planet $$ジェミナイ$$ met the day of its ruin.
In the decisive battle after the spacetime restoration, it had the $$スフィア$$ of the '$$いがみ合う双子$$' taken from it by $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ and was defeated.

サイデリアルに属していた特殊部隊。\n 隊長はガドライト・メオンサム、副隊長は.en:
A special unit that belonged to $$サイデリアル$$.
Its captain is $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ and its vice-captain is $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$.
It uses the $$アンゲロイＧＥＭ$$ and the $$ディオスク$$ as its main force.
It was sent in as a watcher of $$時の牢獄$$, but on $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s own initiative it acted to wipe out Earth's humanity.
When its captain $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was killed in action in the battle over the spacetime restoration, it left the $$地球圏$$.

A special unit that belonged to $$サイデリアル$$.
Its captain is $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ and its vice-captain is $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$.
It uses the $$アンゲロイＧＥＭ$$ and the $$ディオスク$$ as its main force.
It was originally an elite unit of the military that defended the planet $$ジェミナイ$$, but after being defeated by $$サイデリアル$$ its home planet was devastated, and it was incorporated into $$サイデリアル$$ as it was.
It was secretly sent in as a watcher of $$時の牢獄$$ by $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$, but on $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s own initiative it acted to wipe out Earth's humanity.
When its captain $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was defeated in the battle over the spacetime restoration, it left the $$地球圏$$ and set out on an endless flight from $$サイデリアル$$.
However, with the birth of $$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$, the daughters of $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and $$アンナロッタ$$, hope remains for the survival of the species as well.

破界事変から再世戦争にかけて別次元から現れた謎の生命体。\n 正式名称である「.en:
Mysterious life forms that appeared from another dimension between the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$.
Their official name, 'Dimension-Armed MONster,' was abbreviated to $$ダモン$$, but once multiple types were confirmed, the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation's Institute for Extradimensional Life Research, ADiCR (the A-DiC Institute), carried out a new classification of names.
Their true nature is a form in which a mobile weapon and its pilot's life have been fused together by the effect of the Revive Cells generated by $$ガイオウ$$, the $$破界の王$$. Through Dimensional Beastification (= Violation), combat strength rises dramatically. Dimensional Beasts also have ranks, and depending on the original unit, pilot, and combat strength, they transform into one class or another.
It is impossible to restore a Dimensional-Beastified unit and pilot to their original state, and the pilot's consciousness is basically extinguished. For this reason there is no way to communicate with a $$次元獣$$, but they obey $$ガイオウ$$'s orders and act in an organized manner under his command.
ADiCR is the authority on $$次元獣$$ research, and it was here that the name $$ダモン$$ was coined. However, much of the data brought here by Foundation president $$カルロス$$ $$アクシオン$$ Jr. was in fact collected by the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$, a nation on a parallel-world Earth that had previously been destroyed by Dimensional Beasts, and the names of the various classes are also ones that were used in $$インサラウム$$.

並行世界間に存在する異次元エネルギーの総称。\n 源理の力、オリジン・ローとも.en:
A general term for the extradimensional energy that exists among parallel worlds.
It is also known as the Power of Origin, or $$オリジン・ロー$$.
The first stage of utilizing $$次元力$$ is extracting energy from another dimension, producing amounts of energy that would be impossible under ordinary physics. Even Earth's current hyperspacetime physics has reached a level where this can be controlled to some degree.
However, the ultimate goal of utilizing $$次元力$$ is to elucidate and control the energy that 'establishes the world', which could be rephrased as 'control over phenomena'. In other words, if one could freely control the facts that make object A into object A, it would become possible to transform object A into object B. Likewise, if one could control the fact that oxygen and hydrogen combine to produce water, it would become possible to produce water from entirely different elements.
The most striking example of this is $$時空震動$$, which ignores spacetime itself and alters the very existence of the world - in other words, $$時空震動$$ is caused by $$次元力$$.
This is what is called a 'miracle', a power that could be called all-powerful, but this remains purely a theoretical conclusion, and no prospect of proving it has been established. However, research into the $$スフィア$$ suggests that the extraction and control of $$次元力$$ involves the 'will' of living beings.

Its essence lies in controlling phenomena as one wishes by controlling the will that dwells in all matter, and $$次元力$$ can be called the compelling force behind that. Therefore, if one can communicate one's will to them and manipulate them as one wishes, that becomes control over phenomena, and it can also be said that one has used $$次元力$$.

新世時空震動からの一連の戦いを指す言葉。\n 終盤以降は、時の牢獄の完成による.en:
A term for the series of battles that began with the $$新世時空震動$$.
From the late stage onward, it mainly refers to the battles over the time-stasis phenomenon '$$エタニティ・フラット$$' brought about by the completion of $$時の牢獄$$, and it was supposed to be concluded upon confirmation of $$時の牢獄$$'s complete destruction.
However, with the appearance of $$翠の地球$$ and the invasion of $$サイデリアル$$, the time of its conclusion has become ambiguous.

A term for the series of battles that began with the $$新世時空震動$$.
From the late stage onward, it mainly refers to the battles over the time-stasis phenomenon '$$エタニティ・フラット$$' brought about by the completion of $$時の牢獄$$, and it was supposed to be concluded upon confirmation of $$時の牢獄$$'s complete destruction.
However, with the appearance of $$翠の地球$$ and the invasion of $$サイデリアル$$, the time of its conclusion has become ambiguous.
Incidentally, the series of battles from the complete destruction of $$時の牢獄$$ to the hyperspacetime restoration came to be called the $$天獄戦争$$.

史上初のコーディネイターの男性。そのため「ファーストコーディネイター」\nと呼.en:
A man, the first $$コーディネイター$$ in history. For that reason he is called the '$$ファーストコーディネイター$$'.
While still young, he achieved great accomplishments in a variety of fields, such as scholarship, sports, and the military, and showed people the possibilities of humans through genetic manipulation.
The word '$$コーディネイター$$' that he proposed carries the meaning 'an adjuster who will be a bridge between the new humanity and humanity', but its true meaning was not understood, and as a result $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s came to carry on a long-running feud and conflict.

ＵＣＷの新地球連邦軍の特殊部隊。\n エーデル・ベルナル准将を指揮官に三番隊ま.en:
A special unit of the $$新地球連邦軍$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
There are up to three squads under Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ as commander, and it is made up of their respective captains, $$レーベル・ゲネラール$$, $$シュラン・オペル$$ and $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$, and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$, who is in charge of the research and development division.
Its purpose was to establish order in the confused world immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, but that purpose was full of self-righteousness and was synonymous with conquering the world.
After its ringleader $$エーデル$$ was defeated, the mastermind $$ジエー$$, in the true form of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, challenged $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ but was defeated, and $$カイメラ$$ was annihilated as well.

A special unit of the $$新地球連邦軍$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
There are up to three squads under Brigadier General $$エーデル・ベルナル$$ as commander, and it is made up of their respective captains, $$レーベル・ゲネラール$$, $$シュラン・オペル$$ and $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$, and $$ジエー・ベイベル$$, who is in charge of the research and development division.
Its purpose was to establish order in the confused world immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, but that purpose was full of self-righteousness and was synonymous with conquering the world.
After its ringleader $$エーデル$$ was defeated, the mastermind $$ジエー$$, in the true form of $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, challenged $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ but was defeated, and $$カイメラ$$ was annihilated as well.
It was later revealed that its very existence had been part of $$ジエー$$'s plan to overthrow the $$御使い$$.

サイデリアルに属する特殊部隊。\n 「きしゅく」と読む。\n 隊長は尸空、副隊.en:
A special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
It is read 'Kishuku'.
The commander is $$尸空#pilot$$ and the vice commander is $$尸刻$$.
Its main forces are the $$アンゲロイＣＡＮ$$ and the $$尸冥爪$$.
Originally a race living on the frontier of the galaxy, whose mission was to govern the 'power that seeks to vanish' within humans, that is, death. However, $$サイデリアル$$ set its sights on that power, destroyed the whole clan, and incorporated them into $$サイデリアル$$ as they were.
The members control $$次元力$$ by manipulating the 'power that seeks to vanish', and with it they pilot the $$尸冥爪$$.

ザフト軍エリート部隊クルーゼ隊隊長。\n 常に素顔をマスクで隠し、どこか危険な.en:
Commander of the $$クルーゼ隊$$, an elite unit of the $$ザフト$$ military.
A man of many mysteries who always hid his true face behind a mask and gave off an air of danger.
He not only went to the front as a pilot with advanced piloting skill, but was also an excellent military strategist, and racked up numerous achievements through his sharp judgment and, at times, a ruthless capacity for action that stopped at no means if it served his goal.
Trusted by $$パトリック$$, and also holding a high position in the military, he had a certain amount of say with the $$プラント$$ Council.
His true identity is a clone of $$ムウ$$'s father, $$アル・ダ・フラガ$$, but because his telomeres, which govern the length of a lifespan, were short, he had been branded a failure.
Out of despair at being unable to find his own existence anywhere in the world, he convinced himself that he was the judge of the world, and out of that warped thinking he plotted to bring about the extinction of humanity.
After learning the true identity of $$キラ$$, he stubbornly denied the existence of $$キラ$$, who, though likewise one of the 'created', was a success, and fought a fierce battle to the death in the Second Battle of $$ヤキン・ドゥーエ$$.
In the end he was defeated by $$キラ$$, and vanished, engulfed in the light of the giant gamma-ray laser cannon '$$ジェネシス$$'.

ＵＮ上のサイト「オカルトフォーラム」に書き込む際のハンドルネーム。\n 元々は.en:
The handle name used when posting to the site '$$オカルトフォーラム$$' on the $$ＵＮ$$.
It was originally a nickname given to him by his older sister, and carries her wish that he become a strong man who could protect himself.

ビスト財団やネオ・ジオンなど様々な勢力が探し求めている何か。\n 「箱が開かれ.en:
Something that various forces, including the $$ビスト財団$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$, are searching for.
It is said that 'when the box is opened, the $$連邦政府$$ will perish', and because the coordinates of its location are revealed by the '$$Ｌａ＋（ラプラス）システム$$' mounted on the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ is called the 'key' that opens the box.

Something that various forces, including the $$ビスト財団$$ and $$ネオ・ジオン$$, are searching for.
It is said that 'when the box is opened, the $$連邦政府$$ will perish', and because the coordinates of its location are revealed by the '$$Ｌａ＋（ラプラス）システム$$' mounted on the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$, the $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ is called the 'key' that opens the box.
Its true nature is the stone monument of the true $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter that $$サイアム・ビスト$$, the founder of the $$ビスト財団$$, had kept hidden. Its final article, 'If, in the future, the emergence of a new humanity adapted to space is recognized, those persons shall be given priority in taking part in the administration of the government', has been deleted from the $$宇宙世紀$$ Charter that is currently made public.

フルネームはレーベン・ゲネラール。\n ＵＣＷの新地球連邦軍の軍人。\n エー.en:
Full name: $$レーベン・ゲネラール$$.
A soldier of the New Earth Federation Forces of the $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Captain of the 1st Squad of $$カイメラ$$, which is under $$エーデル$$'s direct command, with the rank of captain.
He is close friends with Captain $$シュラン$$ of the 2nd Squad of $$カイメラ$$.
Believing in the ideals of $$エーデル・ベルナル$$, he fights to reform the New Earth Federation Forces and to establish order in the multiverse.
During his infiltration of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$, he pretended to be an earnest, naive, likable young man in order to put others off their guard. However, his true personality is hysterical and self-centered, and going beyond a mere phobia, he loathes the very existence of women.
The one and only exception to his hatred of women is $$エーデル$$, and he openly declares that he would give even his life for her.
Defeated in the decisive battle with $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ set at the central station of the $$ＵＮ$$, and told that $$エーデル・ベルナル$$, whom he had worshiped, was a puppet of Dr. $$ジエー$$, he met his final moments in a state of frenzy.

フルネームは柏葉真紀。\n 第２新東京市立総合病院に務める看護師。\n 特別室.en:
Her full name is $$柏葉真紀$$.
A nurse working at $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
She is in charge of the patients with '$$血塗られた眼$$' who are hospitalized in the special ward.
A cheerful woman who looks after others well and is also capable of delicate consideration, she continues to nurse with devotion even the patients, who show almost no emotion.
After $$時空修復$$, she hopes for the recovery of the patients, whose fits have subsided.

第２新東京市立総合病院に務める看護師。\n 特別室に入院している「血塗られた眼.en:
A nurse working at $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
She is in charge of the patients with '$$血塗られた眼$$' who are hospitalized in the special ward.
A cheerful woman who looks after others well and is also capable of delicate consideration, she continues to nurse with devotion even the patients, who show almost no emotion.
During the fighting against $$サイデリアル$$, she thought there was something she could do too, volunteered as a nursing soldier, and went to the battlefield.
While a nurse, she is also a member of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists' Action Unit, and like the other members she places blind trust in the unit's captain, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.
However, she could no longer tell whether that trust was her own will or mental control by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and in the end her sense of self collapsed.
After the $$超時空修復$$ she loses her memories of the fighting, but begins working as a nurse once again.

「戦いこそ万物の原理」を教義とする汎銀河宗教結社。\n ギルガメス、バララント.en:
A pan-galactic religious society whose doctrine holds that 'conflict is the principle governing all things.'
It is widely worshipped across both the $$ギルガメス$$ and $$バララント$$ factions. Among military personnel in particular, one's battle achievements translate directly into rank within $$マーティアル$$, and it has numerous devout believers.
The one who unites it all is the $$法皇$$, who wields great power.
Regarding $$キリコ・キュービィー$$, who bowed to no one and even did away with $$ワイズマン#pilot$$, it had been decided that he would be recognized as 'the Untouchable One' and left alone. However, Cardinal $$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$, to bolster his standing in the upcoming election for $$法皇$$, ordered his daughter $$テイタニア$$ to assassinate $$キリコ$$, and this became the incident that triggered the collapse of $$マーティアル$$'s authority.

Later, it came to light that the true identity of the god worshipped by $$マーティアル$$ was $$ワイズマン#pilot$$.

破嵐万丈の父、破嵐創造が火星開拓作業、ひいては人類の宇宙進出のために\n製作し.en:
Cyborgs built by $$破嵐創造$$, father of $$破嵐万丈$$, for the Mars development work and, by extension, for humanity's advance into space. Though originally human, they call themselves 'beings beyond humanity' and come to fight humanity with the aim of turning all of humanity into $$メガノイド$$s.
Their leader is $$ドン・ザウサー$$, and under the close aide $$コロス$$, the commander-class 'Commanders' and the soldier 'Soldiers' work in the shadows as the operational force.
Commanders can grow huge through the power of the Macro Cells implanted in their bodies and transform into 'Megaborgs'.

ガルガンティア船団における職業の一つ。\n 手紙や荷物等の配達を請け負い、宛先.en:
One of the occupations in the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.
A courier who takes on the delivery of letters, packages and the like and brings them to the person they are addressed to, also using a backpack-type glider to move from ship to ship.

前パラダイム社社長のゴードン・ローズウォーターの著書。\n ４０年以上前に起き.en:
A book written by $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$, the former president of Paradigm Corporation.
It is said to depict the end of the world that occurred more than 40 years ago, but the truth of this is unknown.

イングレッサ領とボルジャーノ領が保有する軍隊。\n 『イングレッサ・ミリシャ』.en:
The military forces held by the $$イングレッサ$$ territory and the $$ボルジャーノ$$ territory.
They are referred to with the territory they belong to placed at the front, as in the '$$イングレッサ$$ $$ミリシャ$$'.
Until they began direct negotiations with the $$ムーンレィス$$, they possessed only weapons reminiscent of the Industrial Revolution era, such as biplanes and cannons. But ever since the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$ emerged from the $$ホワイトドール$$, they unearthed mobile suits one after another from the $$マウンテンサイクル$$ and strengthened their armament.

フルネームは白井美沙子。\n 第２新東京市立総合病院の特別室に入院していた患者.en:
Full name: $$白井美沙子$$.
A patient who had been hospitalized in a special room of $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
Caught up in a dimensional quake together with her family, she alone survived. Afterward, the phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$' set in, leaving her in a state as if all emotion had been lost. Only the emotion of fear remains, and she sometimes cries out in fright at something in a sudden fit.
As the completion of $$時の牢獄$$ drew near, the number of seizures had been increasing, but after the spacetime restoration they have calmed down, and recovery is hoped for.
