A patient who had been hospitalized in a special room of $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
Caught up in a dimensional quake together with her family, she alone survived. Afterward, the phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$' set in, leaving her in a state as if all emotion had been lost. Only the emotion of fear remains, and she sometimes cries out in fright at something in a sudden fit.
As the completion of $$時の牢獄$$ drew near, the number of seizures had been increasing, but after the spacetime restoration they have calmed down, and recovery is hoped for.
When her spirit particles (i.e. life force) were absorbed by the $$霊子吸収システム$$ built by the $$御使い$$, the $$血塗られた眼$$ set in again, but with the defeat of the $$御使い$$ she completely overcame the symptoms and showed herself in good health.

Ｉフィールドに乗せて人工の物質を砂状に分解する機能を持った無数のナノ\nマシン.en:
A system that scatters countless nanomachines, riding on an I-Field, that have the function of breaking artificial materials down into sand.
Mounted on the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$ and the $$ターンＸ$$, it is recorded in the $$黒歴史$$ as having destroyed the scientific civilization of the former century.
The ejected nanomachines reflect light and shine in rainbow colors, looking like the wings of a butterfly.

黒歴史時代の遺産が数多く眠る山々の総称。\n ナノマシンによって形成された土壌.en:
A general term for the mountains where many legacies of the era of the $$黒歴史$$ lie dormant.
They are covered with soil formed by nanomachines, and from them have been excavated various mobile suits and their weapons, beginning with the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$, and even space battleships.
Similar places exist on the Moon as well, and $$ギム・ギンガナム$$ made use of them.
Some $$マウンテンサイクル$$ were dangerous and feared by miners, such as the '$$ロスト・マウンテン$$', said to hold a large number of live nuclear missiles in storage.

星間軍事連合サイデリアルが蒼の地球上に造り上げた国家。\n 「ガイアエンパイア.en:
A nation built on $$蒼の地球$$ by the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
It is called the '$$ガイアエンパイア$$', or 'the Empire'.
Its supreme ruler, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, is also the ruler of all of $$サイデリアル$$.
In each area it subdues, it builds a $$ターミナル・ベース$$ as a stronghold, from which extend the $$次元力$$ supply lines called $$レイライン$$s. These are bundled at the strategic base $$セントラル・ベース$$, and the $$レイライン$$s extending from $$セントラル・ベース$$ are in turn gathered at the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$.
With overwhelming force it trampled the Earth Federation Forces, who had been worn down by the $$時獄戦役$$, and in a short time brought nearly the whole Earth under its control.

A nation built on $$蒼の地球$$ by the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
It is called the '$$ガイアエンパイア$$', or 'the Empire'.
Its supreme ruler, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, is also the ruler of all of $$サイデリアル$$.
In each area it subdues, it builds a $$ターミナル・ベース$$ as a stronghold, from which extend the $$次元力$$ supply lines called $$レイライン$$s. These are bundled at the strategic base $$セントラル・ベース$$, and the $$レイライン$$s extending from $$セントラル・ベース$$ are in turn gathered at the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$.
With overwhelming force it trampled the Earth Federation Forces, who had been worn down by the $$時獄戦役$$, and in a short time brought nearly the whole Earth under its control.
In the decisive battle at the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$, the executives $$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$ and $$バルビエル$$, and $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, were defeated, and the Empire was destroyed.
Most of the remaining soldiers left the $$地球圏$$, but some who had surrendered, captivated by the planet Earth, requested asylum.

正式名称は国際連合直属非公開組織特務機関ＮＥＲＶ。\n 使徒殲滅を主要目的とす.en:
Its formal name is the Special Agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$, a non-public organization directly under the United Nations.
An extralegal organization whose main purpose is the annihilation of Angels, it has branches in various countries.
Its headquarters are in $$第３新東京市$$ in Japan, with $$碇ゲンドウ$$ as Supreme Commander and $$冬月コウゾウ$$ as Deputy Commander.
Much about its existence is a mystery.

マーティアルによって生み出された改造兵士。\n 補助脳と呼ばれる戦闘処理システ.en:
A modified soldier created by $$マーティアル$$.
Having a combat processing system called an auxiliary brain and a body modified to match it, they are said to have combat power comparable to that of an $$ＡＴ$$ even without a machine.
Their artificial blood must be replaced periodically, and if it deteriorates, they can no longer demonstrate their original specs.

二つの日本列島の内、南側に位置する日本。\n ブリタニア・ユニオンの植民地とな.en:
The Japan located on the southern side of the two Japanese archipelagos.
It became a colony of the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$, and its name of 'Japan' was once taken from it, but with the reorganization of the Earth Federation, it newly gained the name '$$新日本$$'.

第２新東京市立総合病院に務める看護師である柏葉真紀のこと。\n ボランティア部.en:
This refers to $$柏葉真紀$$, a nurse who works at $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
People connected with the Volunteer Club call her this out of affection.
She is a woman in charge of the patients with '$$血塗られた眼$$' who are hospitalized in a special room. Cheerful and caring, and attentive to the smallest details, she continues to nurse with devotion even those patients who show almost no emotion.
After the spacetime restoration, she hopes for the recovery of the patients, whose seizures have subsided.

独立を掲げたジオン公国と地球連邦との戦争。\n 開戦から終戦までが約１年間だっ.en:
The war between the $$ジオン公国$$, which declared independence, and the Earth Federation.
It is called by this name because roughly a year passed between the opening of hostilities and the end of the war.
The $$一年戦争$$ was the first in history to field mobile suits, and it overturned every strategy and tactic that came before.
Though the $$ジオン公国$$ was defeated, thanks to the exploits of the $$ガンダム$$ and of the $$ホワイトベース$$ team to which its pilot $$アムロ$$ belonged, and the covert maneuvers of $$シャア$$, who burned with a desire for revenge against the $$ザビ家$$ that dominated the $$ジオン公国$$, the name of $$ジオン$$ lived on in many changed forms and still carries great weight in the friction between the Spacenoids who live in space and the Earthnoids who live on Earth.

マクロス５船団が銀河系中心近傍のＳ１３５０Ｎ３６０５宙域で発見し、命\n名した.en: A planet discovered and named by the $$マクロス５船団$$ in the S1350N3605 sector near the center of the Milky Way. A lush green planet resembling Earth, it holds the sleeping ruins of the $$プロトカルチャー$$.

A planet discovered and named by the $$マクロス５船団$$ in the S1350N3605 sector near the center of the Milky Way. A lush green planet resembling Earth, it held the sleeping ruins of the $$プロトカルチャー$$, but it was engulfed in the self-destruction of $$ギギル$$, one of the $$プロトデビルン$$, and vanished.

遥か５０万年以上前に栄えていた文明。\n 宇宙に生息する生命体の中で、初めて文.en:
A civilization that flourished far more than 500,000 years ago.
Because they were the first species among the life forms inhabiting space to possess culture, they named themselves '$$プロトカルチャー$$'.
They possessed great technological power, creating the $$ゼントラーディ$$ and the $$メルトランディ$$ at the end of an interstellar war. Later they created the group of biological weapons called the '$$エビル・シリーズ$$' as a still further weapon, but the $$プロトデビルン$$, born when spiritual energy from another dimension took possession of the $$エビル・シリーズ$$, drove them to extinction except for a few.
Their ruins remain on planets in various parts of space.

プロトカルチャーが創造した生体兵器群「エビル・シリーズ」に意思を持つ\nエネル.en:
Beings born when energy life forms possessing will took possession of the group of biological weapons called the '$$エビル・シリーズ$$', created by the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
They feed on $$スピリチア$$, the bioenergy of humans, and the $$プロトカルチャー$$ is said to have been destroyed by the $$プロトデビルン$$.
They were sealed by the $$プロトカルチャー$$ 500,000 years ago, but awoke under the influence of Earth's humanity, which keeps increasing on a galactic scale, and this led to the start of the $$バロータ戦役$$.

Beings born when energy life forms possessing will took possession of the group of biological weapons called the '$$エビル・シリーズ$$', created by the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
They feed on $$スピリチア$$, the bioenergy of humans, and the $$プロトカルチャー$$ is said to have been destroyed by the $$プロトデビルン$$.
They were sealed by the $$プロトカルチャー$$ 500,000 years ago, but awoke under the influence of Earth's humanity, which keeps increasing on a galactic scale, and this led to the start of the $$バロータ戦役$$.
Influenced by the song of $$熱気バサラ$$, the $$プロトデビルン$$ evolved into a species that regenerates $$スピリチア$$ by singing songs themselves. The need to 'absorb $$スピリチア$$' disappeared.

ＡＤＷのブリタニア・ユニオンで行なわれた時空震動実験。\n 時空震動の発生に失.en:
A $$時空震動|lc$$ experiment conducted in the $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$ of the $$ＡＤＷ$$.
Not only did it fail to generate a $$時空震動|lc$$, it also distorted spacetime outside the place where the experiment was conducted.
The first $$次元獣$$ in history appeared from it, and the town of $$オーティス$$ was wiped out, leaving only $$エスター・エルハス$$. $$クロウ・ブルースト$$, who belonged to $$ファイヤバグ$$ and had been dispatched to clean up afterward, opposed the captain, $$マリリン・キャット$$, who feared the trouble and tried to kill $$エスター・エルハス$$, and protected her life.
Incidentally, owing to the failure of this experiment and its effects on the surroundings at the time, the project came to be frozen.

次元将の生成するナノマシン。\n 機動兵器と搭乗者の生命を融合させて次元獣化（.en:
Nanomachines generated by a $$次元将$$.
They fuse the lives of a mobile weapon and its pilot to cause conversion into a $$次元獣$$ (= $$ヴァイオレイション$$), giving birth to a $$次元獣$$.
Which grade of $$次元獣$$ it becomes at that time is determined by the original unit, its pilot, and their combat power.

イオリアに生み出された生体端末。老化抑制が施されているため、月日が経\n過して.en:
A biological terminal created by $$イオリア$$. Because aging suppression was applied, no outward change whatsoever is seen even as months and years pass.
At one time $$リボンズ$$ served $$アレハンドロ$$, then worked behind the scenes, urging the founding of $$アロウズ$$ and more, seeking to rule the humanity he looked down on.
However, the original purpose of his existence lay in having been created to promote the evolution of humanity.
Eventually, $$リボンズ$$ analyzed the $$ツインドライヴ$$ of the $$ダブルオー$$ and installed it in his own unit, the $$リボーンズガンダム$$, and fought on equal or better terms with $$刹那$$, who had awakened as a pure-blooded Innovator. In the midst of the fierce battle, $$リボンズ$$ seized one of the $$ダブルオーライザー$$'s $$ＧＮドライヴ$$s. By coincidence, he met the $$０ガンダム$$ that he himself had once piloted, and faced $$刹那$$, who had switched to the $$ガンダムエクシアリペアⅡ$$, in the final decisive battle, but was defeated and died.

正式な名称はリモネシア共和国。\n 太平洋に浮かぶ島国であり、数年前までは漁業.en:
Its official name is the Republic of $$リモネシア$$.
An island nation floating in the Pacific Ocean, until several years ago it was a small country whose main industries were fishing and tourism. However, with the discovery of $$ＤＥＣ$$, its international standing rose all at once, and through the efforts of the then Foreign Minister $$シオニー・レジス$$, it grew into a nation occupying an important position in the world.
However, the $$時空震動|lc$$ '$$カラミティ・バース$$' devastated the area around the capital on the main island, and the government leadership, including the president at the time, was wiped out.

Its official name is the Republic of $$リモネシア$$.
An island nation floating in the Pacific Ocean, until several years ago it was a small country whose main industries were fishing and tourism. However, with the discovery of $$ＤＥＣ$$, its international standing rose all at once, and through the efforts of the then Foreign Minister $$シオニー・レジス$$, it grew into a nation occupying an important position in the world.
However, the $$時空震動|lc$$ '$$カラミティ・バース$$' devastated the area around the capital on the main island, and the government leadership, including the president at the time, was wiped out.
At present reconstruction has progressed, and the islanders live lives that have returned to what they were before, centered on fishing and tourism.

有史以来存在するとも言われている軍需産業複合体で、強い政治への介入力\nを持っ.en:
A military-industrial complex said to have existed since the dawn of recorded history, wielding powerful influence over politics. It is made up of merchants of death who have secretly manipulated wars and reconstructions to reap enormous profits.
It served as the backing organization for $$ブルーコスモス$$, guiding public opinion to provoke war between the $$地球連合$$ and the $$コーディネイター$$s. $$ブルーコスモス$$'s former leader $$ムルタ・アズラエル$$ and current leader $$ロード・ジブリール$$ are also members of $$ロゴス$$. For $$ロゴス$$ as a whole, the goal is precisely to continue the war and pursue profit, and the fact that $$ブルーコスモス$$ raises the banner of eradicating $$コーディネイター$$s is largely due to the personal feelings of those two.
Having no forces of its own, during the previous war it moved the $$地球連合$$ forces in an attempt to annihilate the $$コーディネイター$$s. And after the war, in order to exercise its power more directly, it has had the $$ファントムペイン$$ organized.
After $$デュランダル$$ later exposed its existence and deeds, most of its members were arrested or killed by lynch mobs of enraged citizens. $$ジブリール$$, the last one remaining, had the trump card, the $$レクイエム$$, taken away and was then shot down along with the fleeing ship.

新地球皇国の帝都。\n 中央シベリア高原東部に位置し、世界中のベースから伸びる.en:
The imperial capital of the $$新地球皇国$$.
Located in the eastern part of the Central Siberian Plateau, it is where the $$次元力$$ supply lines called $$レイライン$$s, extending from bases around the world, converge.
A fortress city centered on the Imperial Palace in which $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ resides, it boasts an impregnable defense together with the surrounding lines of defense.

A fortress city centered on the Imperial Palace in which $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ resides, it boasts an impregnable defense together with the surrounding lines of defense.
It was built at the apex of the Earth's geomantic veins, and connecting each $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ that $$インサラウム$$ set up during the $$再世戦争$$ with $$ラース・バビロン$$ forms a regular pentagon. $$インサラウム$$ had also planned to set up a $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ at this location as its final point of conquest, but being forced to withdraw from Earth, it built its last $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on the surface of Mars, at a position that is significant in terms of star charts in relation to it.

かつて北欧に存在していた国家で、ピースクラフト王家が統治していた。\n 完全平.en:
A nation that once existed in Northern Europe, ruled by the $$ピースクラフト$$ royal family.
It upheld complete pacifism, but was destroyed by the $$地球圏統一連合$$, which feared that the spread of that ideology would bring disadvantage to itself.

ジェミニアからジェニオン・ガイが奪ったスフィア。\n 人間の相反する感情を発動.en:
The $$スフィア$$ that $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ seized from $$ジェミニア#robot$$.
It uses opposing human emotions as its activation key.

The $$スフィア$$ that $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ seized from $$ジェミニア#robot$$.
It uses opposing human emotions as its activation key.
Its way of living while holding those contradictions is human itself, and it can be called a miniature of $$至高神ソル$$, the aggregate of the $$スフィア$$. For that reason, it had been surmised that when all twelve $$スフィア$$ were gathered, it would become the core that controls them.

ＵＣＷとＡＤＷ、その他の世界が一つになった巨大な時空震動。\n 規模は巨大では.en:
The enormous spacequake that fused $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$ and other worlds into one.
Vast in scale, but the physical damage was comparatively light, and $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ - culturally similar - grasped the situation quickly and were able to cooperate. As a result, in only three months a huge political body including the space colonies, the Earth Federation, was born, and people's lives returned to calm in a short time.
However, once it became clear that this had completed $$時の牢獄$$, it was suspected that the $$新世時空震動$$ itself had been caused by someone's design, and an explanation is still awaited.

This spacequake was brought about by $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$, one of the $$御使い$$, in order to protect the humans of $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ who were showing signs of evolution: it first fused the two Earths, then split them in two again, using one of them (the $$翠の地球$$) as camouflage to hide the other (the $$蒼の地球$$) from the eyes of the other $$御使い$$.

スフィア「沈黙の巨蟹（きょかい）」のリアクター。\n 巨大な機動兵器、尸逝天（.en:
The Reactor of the $$スフィア$$ known as the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$.
He pilots the massive mobile weapon $$尸逝天$$.
He has stated himself that he belongs to $$鬼宿$$, within the mysterious organization $$サイデリアル$$ to which $$ジェミニス$$ also once belonged, but the full extent of that organization's purpose and structure remains unknown.
A man of few words, he never shows emotion, even in battle.
He had come to Earth to execute $$アンナロッタ$$ for defying some order, but revealed himself to the people of Earth only just before $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed.

第２新東京市立総合病院の特別室に入院していた患者。\n 家族と共に次元震に巻き.en:
A patient who had been hospitalized in a special room of $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
Caught up in a dimensional quake together with their family, the patient alone survived. Afterward, the phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$' set in, leaving them in a state as if all emotion had been lost. Only the emotion of fear remains, and they sometimes cry out in fright at something in a sudden fit.
As the completion of $$時の牢獄$$ drew near, the number of seizures had been increasing, but after the spacetime restoration they have calmed down, and recovery is hoped for.

When their spirit particles (i.e. life force) were absorbed by the $$霊子吸収システム$$ built by the $$御使い$$, the $$血塗られた眼$$ set in again, but with the defeat of the $$御使い$$ they completely overcame the symptoms and showed themselves in good health.

フラタニティに所属する双子の姉妹トップレス。\n 姉がピアジェ、妹がルクルト。.en:
Twin sisters who are $$トップレス$$ belonging to the $$フラタニティ$$.
The older sister is $$ピアジェ$$ and the younger sister is $$ルクルト$$.
Both wear full-body suits and heavy makeup, and have taken the post of general chairperson of the operation to excavate the $$変動重力源|lc$$ on $$タイタン$$, a moon of Jupiter, in which capacity they carry out the revival of the $$変動重力源|lc$$.
They often eat meat called 'Titan crab'.

Twin sisters who are $$トップレス$$ belonging to the $$フラタニティ$$.
The older sister is $$ピアジェ$$ and the younger sister is $$ルクルト$$.
They are a rare type of $$トップレス$$ whose ability manifests in twins, and perhaps because of that ability, in order to stay together the two scheme in pursuit of an 'eternally lasting $$トップレス$$'.
They belong to a mysterious organization called the $$秘密サークル$$.
As part of human experiments to sustain $$トップレス$$, they ate the meat of the $$タイタン変動重力源$$, which they called 'Titan crab'.
The members and collaborators of the $$秘密サークル$$ are found everywhere, from the government of the imperial capital to corporations, financial circles, university and research institute think tanks, and the space military. Even the Buster Machine '$$カランドゥ$$' that the twins ride is originally sealed, and is used as a special exception by means of that circle's political power.
They believe that the $$変動重力源|lc$$ sleeping on $$タイタン$$ is a '$$トップレス$$ from another star'. They took the post of general chairperson of the operation to excavate it and revived the $$変動重力源|lc$$, but their actions ended in an ironic result for the twins: both of them died from the attack of the revived $$変動重力源|lc$$.

ノリコが宇宙戦艦ヱクセリヲンの中で出会ったマシーン兵器パイロットの青\n年。\.en:
A young man, a machine-weapon pilot, whom $$ノリコ$$ met aboard the space battleship $$ヱクセリヲン$$.
Full name: $$スミス・トーレン$$.
Having met by chance at the test-of-courage event held aboard the ship, he often teased $$ノリコ$$ on board, but when $$ノリコ$$ was dropped from her partnership with $$カズミ$$ and was depressed, he encouraged her and became her partner, and the two grew close.
However, in the subsequent battle with the space monsters, he sortied together with $$ノリコ$$ but did not return, and was presumed killed in action.
The trauma of not having been able to save $$スミス$$ became what led $$ノリコ$$ to undergo piloting training for $$ガンバスター$$.
The headband $$ノリコ$$ wears in battle is a keepsake of $$スミス$$.

マクロス７船団の統合軍軍医、Ｄｒ．千葉が研究していたエネルギー。\n 人が歌う.en:
The energy researched by Dr. $$千葉#macross$$, a military doctor of the Unified Forces in the $$マクロス７船団$$.
It is a theory advocating the effects of the waves carried by the songs that people sing, and it was proven through the treatment of people who had lost $$スピリチア$$ to the $$プロトデビルン$$ and through the development of a $$歌エネルギー|lc$$ conversion system.
The amount of energy is expressed in a unit called the '$$チバソング$$'. The $$歌エネルギー|lc$$ of an ordinary person is about 100 $$チバソング$$s, and even an excellent singer is said to be limited to about 1000 $$チバソング$$s.

次元力を制御する謎の機関。\n 黄道十二星座に対応しており、それぞれ人間の精神.en:
A mysterious mechanism that controls $$次元力$$.
It corresponds to the 12 signs of the zodiac, each responding to movements of the human mind and manifesting its power.
It is normally mounted as a power source for mobile weapons, but as a $$スフィア$$'s operational stage advances, it can also be used as a superweapon.

次元力を制御する機関。\n その正体は、１万２０００年前に自我に目覚めた事象制.en:
A mechanism that controls $$次元力$$.
Its true nature is a fragment born when the phenomenon control system '$$至高神ソル$$', which awoke to self-awareness 12,000 years ago, shattered itself.
It corresponds to the 12 signs of the zodiac, each responding to movements of the human mind and manifesting its power.
It is normally mounted as a power source for mobile weapons, but as a $$スフィア$$'s operational stage advances, it can also be used as a superweapon.
The 12 types of $$スフィア$$ and their activation keys are as follows.
- $$偽りの黒羊$$: Activation key 'Lies'
- $$欲深な金牛$$: Activation key 'Desire'
- $$いがみ合う双子$$: Activation key 'Opposing Emotions'
- $$沈黙の巨蟹$$: Activation key 'Void'
- $$傷だらけの獅子$$: Activation key 'Endurance'
- $$悲しみの乙女$$: Activation key 'Sorrow'
- $$揺れる天秤$$: Activation key 'Will'
- $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$: Activation key 'Hatred'
- $$立ち上がる射手$$: Activation key 'Defiance'
- $$知りたがる山羊$$: Activation key 'Curiosity'
- $$尽きぬ水瓶$$: Activation key 'Love'
- $$夢見る双魚$$: Activation key 'Dreams'
There are stages to a $$スフィア$$'s awakening. At the First Stage it is no more than a high-output energy generating mechanism, but from the Second Stage it becomes able to control phenomena. However, awakening a $$スフィア$$ to the Second Stage requires an aptitude suited to that $$スフィア$$, so only chosen humans can use its power. Only once a $$スフィア$$ has been awakened as far as the Second Stage is its user called a Reactor for the first time, but at the same time, the $$スフィア$$'s backlash brings suffering from various symptoms. Because of this backlash, most humans with the aptitude to be a Reactor drop out, but once the further stage, the Third Stage, is reached, the backlash subsides. Also, a Reactor who has awakened a $$スフィア$$ to the Third Stage becomes able to use its power even when at a distance from the $$スフィア$$, and produces various effects called $$スフィア・アクト$$.
Furthermore, each $$スフィア$$ has its compatibilities, and to completely defeat a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ who has reached the Third Stage, one must throw a $$スフィア$$ of poor compatibility against them to seal their power. However, even this becomes almost meaningless once the final phase of the Third Stage is reached, but $$スフィア・リアクター$$s in that state had never fought one another before, so what result it would produce was not actually known.
Through the hyperspacetime restoration, the 8 $$スフィア$$ that had been incorporated into $$至高神Ｚ$$ were completely lost.

相性のいいスフィア間に見られる力の相乗効果。\n 再世戦争で揺れる天秤と尽きぬ.en:
A synergistic effect of power seen between compatible $$スフィア$$s.
The case in the $$再世戦争$$ where the $$揺れる天秤$$ and the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ raised each other's power and returned $$エスター・エルハス$$ from the state of a $$次元獣$$ to normal also falls under this.
Conversely, there are also incompatible combinations of $$スフィア$$s. Compatible combinations benefit both sides, but incompatible combinations mean an advantage for one side, and carry important meaning in battles between Reactors.

A synergistic effect of power seen between compatible $$スフィア$$s.
The case in the $$再世戦争$$ where the $$揺れる天秤$$ and the $$尽きぬ水瓶$$ raised each other's power and returned $$エスター・エルハス$$ from the state of a $$次元獣$$ to normal also falls under this.
Conversely, there are also incompatible combinations of $$スフィア$$s. Compatible combinations benefit both sides, but incompatible combinations mean an advantage for one side, and carry important meaning in battles between Reactors.
The compatibilities between $$スフィア$$s that are known at present are as follows.
Compatible combinations:
- $$揺れる天秤$$ & $$尽きぬ水瓶$$
- $$傷だらけの獅子$$ & $$欲深な金牛$$
Incompatible combinations:
- $$悲しみの乙女$$ > $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$
- $$知りたがる山羊$$ > $$偽りの黒羊$$
- $$偽りの黒羊$$ > $$いがみ合う双子$$
However, these compatibilities have meaning only when the power of the two is evenly matched. When one is greatly inferior, resonance does not occur even with a good compatibility, and no advantage can be gained even with a poor one.

スフィアの所持者。\n 単純にスフィアを搭載した機体のパイロットという意味では.en:
A holder of a $$スフィア$$.
The term does not simply mean the pilot of a unit equipped with a $$スフィア$$, but refers to a person capable of drawing out a $$スフィア$$'s power.

A holder of a $$スフィア$$.
The term does not simply mean the pilot of a unit equipped with a $$スフィア$$, but refers to a person capable of drawing out a $$スフィア$$'s power.
Specifically, a person who has awakened a $$スフィア$$ to the Second Stage or higher is a Reactor, and Reactors themselves are also ranked by Stage according to the state of their $$スフィア$$'s awakening.
Furthermore, at the Third Stage or higher, a person can draw out a $$スフィア$$'s power even when not aboard a unit, and manifest various effects called $$スフィア・アクト$$.

オムニ・スフィア転移反応とも言い、全身の構造材の内部に微細な結晶状の\n電子素.en:
Also called the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ transfer reaction, it is a system that embeds minute crystalline electronic elements inside the structural materials throughout the whole body and links them three-dimensionally, thereby reading the electrical patterns in the operator's brain and transcribing them onto an AI unit.
The name is taken from the initials of 'Transfer And Response $$オムニ・スフィア$$'.
It is also installed in the '$$レディ・チャペル$$' of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$, where it makes it possible for one person to pilot the huge submarine alone through the power of a $$ウィスパード$$.

レナードによってメリダ島に築かれた最大のＴＡＲＯＳ。\n かなめの力を使い思い.en:
The largest $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$, built on $$メリダ島$$ by $$レナード$$.
A device that makes it possible to transform the world as one wishes by using the power of $$かなめ$$, it is used in $$レナード$$'s plan to correct the history that was distorted by the existence of the $$ウィスパード$$.

フルネームはジ・エーデル・ベルナル。\n ＵＣＷの多元戦争の黒幕。\n カイメ.en:
His full name is $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$.
The mastermind behind the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$.
He created $$エーデル・ベルナル$$, the ringleader of $$カイメラ$$ and a brigadier general of the Earth Federation Forces, and controlled world affairs in order to play in a free world of his own desire.
He succeeded in a limited control of the Power of Origin ($$オリジン・ロー$$ / $$次元力$$), and using that power, behaves however his desires lead him. His guiding principle is summed up in a single phrase: 'As long as it's interesting!', and he enjoys the existence of the multitude of worlds born from the $$時空震動弾$$ more than anyone else.
Through his application of the Power of Origin, he has integrated the abilities of his multiple selves existing across parallel worlds, and surpasses ordinary people in every respect.
He is also freed from concepts such as ethics and morality, and since he is driven by desires that others find hard to understand, it is difficult to read his intentions or actions.
It is said that he unraveled the Power of Origin by coming into contact with the $$黒の英知$$ through $$エルガン・ローディック$$, the same person as him in a parallel world.
His true form is a beautiful young man, but until the final battle he played the role of the ugly old scientist $$ジエー・ベイベル$$.
Also, the name '$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$' is merely one of convenience, and his real name is something else.

多元戦争の際にメール・ビーターに見られた現象。\n 生物としての時間が停止して.en:
A phenomenon seen in $$メール・ビーター$$ during the $$多元戦争$$.
Her biological time is stopped, and neither growth nor aging can be seen.
It was surmised that the $$時の牢獄$$ created by the $$新世時空震動$$ would rewrite not a single life but the laws of the entire world into this.

A phenomenon seen in $$メール・ビーター$$ during the $$多元戦争$$.
Her biological time is stopped, and neither growth nor aging can be seen.
This was a measure taken by the $$スフィア$$ of the $$傷だらけの獅子$$ to hold fast the soul of $$メール$$, who had once lost her life, but as a result the $$スフィア$$ had come to exist split between the $$ガンレオン$$ and $$メール$$. However, when $$ランド$$ awakened as a Reactor, the $$スフィア$$ within $$メール$$ was torn away and integrated within the $$ガンレオン$$, and $$メール$$'s time began to move.
It was surmised that the $$時の牢獄$$ created by the $$新世時空震動$$ would rewrite not a single life but the laws of the entire world into this.

主に子供に発現する超能力の能力者。\n 能力自体は子供であれば誰にでも発現する.en:
Users of psychic powers that manifest mainly in children.
The ability itself manifests in any child, but its magnitude and orientation vary from individual to individual, and among them, children with especially great ability are scouted by the $$フラタニティ$$ and become pilots of the $$バスターマシン$$.
When they activate their ability, a phenomenon occurs in which the head shines brilliantly, and the intensity of that light is proportional to the magnitude of the ability.
As they approach adulthood, the ability declines, and eventually there comes a time called '$$あがり$$', when it is lost entirely (100%).

堕天翅族の聖天翅で、天翅達を束ねる前線指揮官。\n 後頭部に翅を持つが、それ以.en:
A $$聖天翅$$ of the $$堕天翅$$ tribe, and a frontline commander who leads the $$天翅$$s.
Although he has wings on the back of his head, in every other respect he has the appearance closest to a human among the $$堕天翅$$.
Twelve thousand years ago, he was betrothed to $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the strongest of the $$守護天翅$$s. But at the end of the $$アトランディア大戦$$, $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ betrayed the $$堕天翅$$ tribe, and they crossed blades as enemies. Even so, that love had still not faded, and he approached $$アポロ$$, apparently the reincarnation of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, again and again.
In the course of the fighting he killed $$アポロ$$'s close friend $$バロン$$, and tormented $$アポロ$$ and the others by every means, such as cunningly tempting $$シリウス$$ into switching sides. But when the $$生命の樹$$ withered and the world faced the crisis of its end, he even teleported to $$ベクタールナ$$ to try to stop it. Even then he remained out of step with $$アポロ$$ and $$シリウス$$, but through the memories of $$セリアン$$ that $$シルヴィア$$ showed, he learned that $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ of long ago had not betrayed them but had wished for coexistence between the $$天翅$$s and humans. Once his resolve to carry on $$アポロニアス#pilot$$'s will was firm, the three of them succeeded in $$創聖合体$$ and held the shattering world together.

蒼の地球とその周辺を巻き込んだ次元結界。\n 新世時空震動によって生まれ、徐々.en:
A dimensional barrier that engulfed $$蒼の地球$$ and its surroundings.
Born from the $$新世時空震動$$, it transformed the world into one governed by a law under which the flow of time for living things gradually falls to zero.
Through the spacetime restoration at the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, the laws of the world were destroyed together with the dimensional barrier, and the time of living things returned to normal.

A dimensional barrier that engulfed $$蒼の地球$$ and its surroundings.
Born from the $$新世時空震動$$, it transformed the world into one governed by a law under which the flow of time for living things gradually falls to zero.
This was $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$'s means of halting evolution by taking the future away from humanity, and had the dimensional barrier been completed, the humanity of Earth could have lived forever. However, it came to be denied by the collective will of humanity.
Through the spacetime restoration at the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, the laws of the world were destroyed together with the dimensional barrier, and the time of living things returned to normal.

並行世界の一つ（＝『スーパーロボット大戦Ｚ』の世界）。\n その名は「宇宙世紀.en:
One of the parallel worlds (= the world of 'Super Robot Wars Z').
The name is short for '$$宇宙世紀$$ World'.
In the chaos immediately after the $$大時空震動$$, the $$多元戦争$$ broke out.
It is marked by violent displacement of land by spacequakes: apart from places such as the Japanese archipelago, the shape of its continents changed drastically from the old Earth.

ＵＣＷで使用されていた情報ネットワークシステム。\n 「Ｕｎｉｖｅｒｓａｌ Ｎ.en:
The information network system used in $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Short for 'Universal Network' and pronounced 'U-N'.
It was laid down to unify and share information across the multiverse, and anyone with a terminal can read or publish on it.
A valuable source of information for citizens and an entertainment medium at the same time, it became a critically important piece of infrastructure across the multiverse.
It was adopted as the unified standard for information infrastructure in the world after the $$新世時空震動$$ as well.

The information network system used in $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Short for 'Universal Network' and pronounced 'U-N'.
It was laid down to unify and share information across the multiverse, and anyone with a terminal can read or publish on it.
A valuable source of information for citizens and an entertainment medium at the same time, it became a critically important piece of infrastructure across the multiverse.
It was adopted as the unified standard for information infrastructure in the world after the $$新世時空震動$$ as well, but some of its communication functions were restricted by $$サイデリアル$$.

月育ちで「宇宙戦闘の天才」と呼ばれる凄腕パイロット。宇宙に上がったば\nかりの.en:
A skilled pilot raised on the Moon and called a 'genius of space combat'. She challenged $$カズミ$$, who had only just gone up into space, to a duel, and after the duel was over she treated $$カズミ$$ warmly; her emotions swing so violently that one might suspect a split personality.
Her strictness in battle is thorough, and there were times she gave up on $$ノリコ$$ when $$ノリコ$$ was about to be crushed by fear.
She was paired with $$ノリコ$$ as a pilot of the $$ガンバスター$$ after $$カズミ$$ married $$コーチ$$, but in the final battle she handed the $$ガンバスター$$ over to $$カズミ$$. She herself fought the space monsters in the $$シズラー$$ and survived safely.

イオリア・シュヘンベルグの計画の根幹を成す量子演算システム。\n 通常のコンピ.en:
A quantum computing system that forms the foundation of $$イオリア$$ Schoenberg's plan.
Possessing information-processing power beyond comparison with ordinary computers, it was a great source of strength enabling $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ to fight against the entire world.
However, with $$リボンズ・アルマーク$$'s cooperation, $$ヴェーダ$$ was seized by $$アレハンドロ・コーナー$$, and after his death it fell into $$リボンズ$$'s hands.
Its main body is located inside the mothership $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.

現在の技術体系では開発されていないテクノロジーを知る特殊な人間。\n それらの.en:
Special individuals who possess knowledge of technologies not yet developed within the current body of technical knowledge.
These technologies, which by rights should not exist, are called Black Technology, and depending on how they are used, they can completely overturn the current military balance. For this reason, various organizations have schemed to capture the $$ウィスパード$$, and $$ミスリル$$ acts to protect them.
Black Technology manifests in a $$ウィスパード$$'s mind at some chance trigger, as though someone were whispering to them, but the system and cause behind this phenomenon remain unexplained.
The Lambda Driver is likewise a product of Black Technology brought forth by a $$ウィスパード$$.
At present, $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$ and $$千鳥かなめ$$ are known to be $$ウィスパード$$, and it is considered all but certain that $$ウィスパード$$ exist within $$アマルガム$$ as well.

Special individuals who possess knowledge of technologies not yet developed within the current body of technical knowledge.
These technologies, which by rights should not exist, are called Black Technology, and depending on how they are used, they can completely overturn the current military balance. For this reason, various organizations have schemed to capture the $$ウィスパード$$, and $$ミスリル$$ acts to protect them.
Black Technology manifests in a $$ウィスパード$$'s mind at some chance trigger, as though someone were whispering to them, but the system and cause behind this phenomenon remain unexplained.
The Lambda Driver is likewise a product of Black Technology brought forth by a $$ウィスパード$$.
The $$ウィスパード$$ came into being through the effects of an accident that occurred during the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ experiment being conducted at the Soviet Union's experimental facility $$ヤムスク１１$$. All $$ウィスパード$$ are newborns who were born in the three minutes starting at 11:50 on December 24, the day the accident occurred.

神と呼ばれる存在。\n キリコを後継者と定め、ロッチナを始めとする配下の者達を.en:
A being called a god.
Having designated $$キリコ$$ as its successor, it used subordinates, starting with $$ロッチナ$$, to summon $$キリコ$$ to its side.
Its true nature is a collective of the wills of those with extraordinary powers, gathered in a protoplasm preservation device.
It was also an heir to the $$クエント$$ civilization, which perished in the distant past, and, lurking deep within the $$クエント$$ ruins, it used that power to behave like a god and control the wars of $$アストラギウス$$.
In the end, it was betrayed by $$キリコ$$, whom it had chosen as its successor, and its functions were shut down.

ガルガンティア船団の存在する地球で使用されている搭乗型のロボット。\n 正式名.en:
A ride-on robot used on the Earth where the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ exists.
Its formal name is '$$ユンボロイド$$', but the shortened name $$ユンボロ$$ is what is mainly used.
They are basically operated as work machines, for tasks such as hauling supplies and underwater work, but there are also $$ユンボロ$$ specialized for combat, such as those used by pirates.
A legacy of the former civilization called a 'core unit' is used to control the machine.

翠の地球における太平洋の赤道付近一帯を指す。\n 海の色が翠色であるのが特徴。.en:
The whole area around the equator of the Pacific Ocean on $$翠の地球$$.
Its distinguishing feature is that the color of the sea is green.

プロトカルチャーが創造した巨人型戦闘兵士。\n 第一次星間大戦で地球人類と交戦.en:
Giant combat soldiers created by the $$プロトカルチャー$$.
They fought Earth's humanity in the $$第一次星間大戦$$, and coming into contact with Earth's culture during that fighting became the opportunity for mutual understanding to advance and for the path to coexistence to open.
They are normally giants 10 m tall, but by using a '$$マイクローン装置$$' they can shrink to '$$マイクローン$$' size, an Earthling size of about 1.8 m, and can also return from there to their original giant size.
In the $$マイクローン$$ state, interbreeding with Earthlings is possible, and $$マックス$$ and $$ミリア$$, who became the first married couple of an Earthling and a $$ゼントラーディ$$ in history, had many children, including $$ミレーヌ$$.
They have their own language, and there are words that have taken root in Earth languages, beginning with '$$デ・カルチャー$$', which expresses amazement.

ルルーシュがスザクや極少数の協力者と共に秘密裏に完遂させた計画。\n 内容は神.en:
A plan that $$ルルーシュ$$ secretly carried through to completion together with $$スザク$$ and an extremely small number of collaborators.
Its content was this: $$ルルーシュ$$, having ascended to the throne as Emperor of the $$神聖ブリタニア帝国$$, would use that position and military power to rule as a dictator, gathering the anger and hatred of the people onto $$ルルーシュ$$; then, by having $$ルルーシュ$$ struck down by '$$ゼロ$$', played by $$スザク$$, create the fact of '$$ゼロ$$, the hero who defeated the Demon King $$ルルーシュ$$', and so wipe hatred from the world.
Its purpose was for $$ルルーシュ$$ to atone for his own sins with his own life.

ＵＣＷの多元戦争を終結させた独立部隊。\n 「Ｚ Ｅｍｅｒｇｅｎｃｙ Ｕｎｉｏ.en:
The independent unit that brought $$ＵＣＷ$$'s $$多元戦争$$ to an end.
Short for 'Z Emergency Union of Terrestrial Human', meaning 'Earth Human Emergency Rescue Union'.
It fought $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, who sought to control the multiverse as his desires dictated.
After the $$多元戦争$$ ended, it regrouped for the battle against the Executors.
Later, some of its members were displaced to $$ＡＤＷ$$ by the spacequake 'Calamity Birth' that accompanied the appearance of the $$破界の王$$ there. They too fought through the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$ in $$ＡＤＷ$$ before returning to $$ＵＣＷ$$ through the $$アビス$$.

ＡＤＷの破界事変と再世戦争を戦い抜いた独立部隊。\n 破界事変の際、国連平和維.en:
The independent unit that fought through $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$破界事変$$ and $$再世戦争$$.
It was organized during the $$破界事変$$ by $$エルガン・ローディック$$, representative of the UN Peacekeeping Council.
Short for 'Z EXtra International Savers', meaning 'special international rescue team'.
After the spacequake '$$カラミティ・バース$$', members of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ displaced from $$ＵＣＷ$$ joined it as well.
It was disbanded once after the $$破界事変$$ ended, then reformed - at which point it was made an independent external unit with the right to act on its own and the authority to inspect and act upon other units within the Earth Federation.
Across both inter-dimensional wars, the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$, it struck down the enemy leadership of many organizations and brought the fighting to an end.

サイド３に本拠を置くスペースコロニー国家「ジオン共和国」の初代首相。\n シャ.en:
The first prime minister of the space colony nation the '$$ジオン共和国$$', based on $$サイド３$$.
He was the father of $$シャア$$ (real name $$キャスバル・レム・ダイクン$$) and $$セイラ$$ (real name $$アルテイシア・ソム・ダイクン$$), and was also a politician who created the ideology called 'Newtype theory'.
After his death, the $$ジオン共和国$$ became the $$ジオン公国$$, a dictatorship of the $$ザビ家$$.
There are various theories about his death, but the theory that he was murdered by the $$ザビ家$$ is the strongest, and $$シャア$$ also spoke of this theory in a speech.

聖インサラウム王国のアンブローン・ジウスが開発した次元力抽出システム。\nその.en:
A $$次元力$$ extraction system developed by $$アンブローン・ジウス$$ of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$. Its name is short for 'Zodiac Of New Energy.'
It is installed along ley lines to extract the Earth's $$次元力$$, but in $$インサラウム$$, the runaway of $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ caused the land itself to die.
During the $$再世戦争$$, five units were installed on Earth and one on Mars; they still exist today, but all of them have ceased functioning.

新地球皇国に制圧された街を救うため主人公とスズネは潜入を試みる。\n作戦の最中、.en:
The protagonist and Suzune infiltrate a New Earth Empire-held town
to liberate it. But mid-mission, under intense stress, Suzune...

甲児の弟であるシローから子猫捜索の依頼を受ける正太郎とワッ太。\nその陰で再起の.en:
Kouji's little brother Shiro asks Shotaro and Watta to find a kitten.
In the shadows, villains biding their time are about to make a move.

時獄戦役終盤、自らの宿命を知ったリディはバナージに苛立ちを募らせていた。\nシャ.en:
Late in the Time Prison War, Riddhe, aware of his destiny, chafes at Banagher.
Before his showdown with Char, Amuro trains the two and the young Newtypes.

久々に登校した宗介は、いつもの勘違いでかなめを怒らせてしまう。\n一人になったか.en:
Sousuke, back at school at last, angers Kaname with his usual blunder.
As evil closes in on the now-alone Kaname, a strange animal (?) swoops in.

新地球皇国の侵攻に対してレジスタンスとして抵抗を続ける五飛。\n人々の誇りを背負.en:
Wufei fights on in the resistance against the New Earth Empire's invasion.
When he, bearing the people's pride, is cornered, kindred spirits appear.

ノノの発した「正統派スーパーロボット乗り」の言葉を気にする勝平は、\nその答えを.en:
Kappei, bothered by Nono's words "classic super robot pilot,"
seeks the answer and gets advice from Takeru and Noriko.

新日本に迫る新地球皇国の大部隊を迎え撃つゼロ。\nそして、あの男が熱いサウンドと.en:
Zero intercepts a large New Earth Empire force bearing down on New Japan.
And that man flies over Tokyo, now a battlefield, with his fiery sound.

大きな戦いを前にしてささやかな宴を楽しんでいた一行は、\nレジスタンスの食糧輸送.en:
Enjoying a modest feast before the big battle, the group
burns with rage at Girtar for attacking the resistance's food convoy.

皇国に苦戦するレジスタンス達は、「獣」と「風」の噂を心の支えとする。\nその期待.en:
The resistance, beset by the Empire, cling to rumors of "Beast" and "Wind."
To live up to their hopes, Team D and Team Dai-Gurren fight hard.

エグゼクター事件が終結した直後のＵＣＷで、未だ余所余所しいシンとキラと\n二人を.en:
Right after the Executor Incident in the UCW, still-distant Shinn and Kira
and Kamille, worried about them both, run into a new Zeon.

時獄戦役後、フィアナを失ったキリコは生きる目的を喪失していた。\nそんなある日、.en:
After the Time Prison War, Chirico, without Fyana, has lost all purpose.
One day, in the Battling he keeps up out of habit, he meets Kei again.

サルディアスの指揮するターミナル・ベースをかく乱するため、\n普段は前線に出ない.en:
To throw the Terminal Base under Sardias's command into chaos,
crew who normally stay off the front lines fight with their own skills.

ショックを受けて気落ちするエレメントを鍛えるゲッターチーム。\nその訓練に赤木は.en:
The Getter Team trains the Elements, who are shaken and dispirited.
Akagi invites the emotionally scarred Shinji and the others to join.

ガルガンティア船団に戻ったレドを見舞うアクシデント。\n窮地に陥ったレドとチェイ.en:
An accident befalls Ledo after his return to the Gargantia Fleet.
In a tight spot, how will Ledo and Chamber face the oncoming Sidereal?

エグゼクター事件後の日々を思い出すロランとガロードは、\nマウンテンサイクルから.en:
Recalling the days after the Executor Incident, Loran and Garrod
tell of their battle with mysterious mobile suits from the Mountain Cycle.

バスターマシンは心を持ち、パイロットの想いに応えてくれる……。\nチコは、キャト.en:
Buster Machines have hearts and answer their pilots' feelings...
Tycho tells of vying with Nono for the Quatre-Vingt-Dix pilot's seat.

ふとしたきっかけでにらみ合う事となったＳ．Ｍ．ＳとミスリルのＳＲＴ。\n彼等はそ.en:
A chance incident pits S.M.S. against Mithril's SRT in a standoff.
Each staking its own pride and honor, they take on the terrorists.

新地球皇国に追われていた民間のシャトルを保護したグラハム達。\n彼等は、そのシャ.en:
Graham's group shields a civilian shuttle chased by the New Earth Empire.
Aboard it, they meet someone with deep ties to Setsuna.

絶望の未来という言葉とパラダイムシティを結びつけるロジャーと万丈。\n彼等とアポ.en:
Roger and Banjo link the words "a future of despair" to Paradigm City.
With Apollo, they pursue the strange book "Metropolis" to learn the truth.

時獄戦役での遺恨の決着をつけるため、女性同士の意地と誇りがぶつかり合う。\n今再.en:
To settle grudges from the Time Prison War, the women's pride collides.
Once again on a merciless field, Miss Combat... Miss Con for short, begins!

さらなる戦いを前にＡＧが用意したスペシャルなシミュレーションステージ。\n大地を.en:
A special simulation stage prepared by AG ahead of further battles.
Can the group defeat the mighty old foes closing in across the land?

さらなる戦いを前にＡＧが用意したスペシャルなシミュレーションステージ。\n宇宙を.en:
A special simulation stage prepared by AG ahead of further battles.
Can the group defeat the mighty old foes closing in across space?

火星に向かったクロウ達は、そこでファイヤバグ残党と遭遇する。\nマリリン・キャッ.en:
Heading to Mars, Crowe's group encounters the Firebug remnants.
Before Marilyn Catto's grave, Firebug's final battle begins.

決戦を前にＡＧが用意した超スペシャルなシミュレーションステージ。\n次元力を操る.en:
A super-special simulation stage prepared by AG before the final battle.
Can the group defeat the mighty old foes who wield Dimensional Power?

This icon lights up when the unit can transform.

ＵＣＷの戦乱を影からコントロールしていた秘密組織『カイメラ』。\nそのメンバーが.en:
$$カイメラ$$: the secret organization that steered the $$ＵＣＷ$$'s wars
from the shadows. The ID badges its members wore were said to amplify
human desire... or maybe not.

破界事変の戦いを駆け抜けた戦士達の闘志を封じたと言われる幻の逸品。\n破界の王に.en:
A fabled item said to hold the fighting spirit of the warriors
of the $$破界事変$$. Some say it is a charm to soothe the rage
and grief of people the $$破界の王$$ made $$次元獣$$s.

再世戦争の末期、人々の世界の再生への願いを封じたと言われる幻の逸品。\n自らの身.en:
A fabled item said to hold people's wishes for the world's rebirth
late in the $$再世戦争$$. Some say it is the feelings of a prince
who risked his life for his people, and of his supporters, given form.

失われし聖王国インサラウムに代々伝わっていた秘宝の一つ。\nキング・インサラウム.en:
One of the treasured heirlooms of the lost Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$.
Said to be King $$インサラウム$$ I's "love" for his people given form,
it grants its holder great power, but only once.

聖インサラウム王国の次元化学の結晶の一つ。\n使用者の意志や生命力をキーとして次.en:
One fruit of the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$'s dimensional science.
Keyed to the user's will and life force, it draws $$次元力$$
to power up the weapons of the unit they pilot.

量子演算による統合戦術情報伝達ＡＩシステム。\n周辺の友軍機は、本システムを装備.en:
Quantum-computing AI system for integrated tactical data relay.
Allied units nearby that link to the unit equipped with it
receive precise tactical command.

次元力の応用による万能修理・補給システム。\n欠損パーツの補修や給弾などに対し、.en:
An all-purpose repair/resupply system applying $$次元力$$.
It makes something from nothing to fix lost parts, reload ammo, etc.,
so it can handle every type of machine.

防御行動に特化した自動操縦システム。\nそのＡＩには、とある星系の非常に臆病な小.en:
An autopilot system specialized in defensive actions.
Its AI models a very timid small animal from a certain star system,
and picks the best defense faster than human reflexes.

移動距離に応じて資金が得られる報酬システム。\n某星系での万歩計の歩数に応じて特.en:
A reward system that pays out funds based on distance moved.
It piggybacks on a campaign in some star system that rewards pedometer
step counts, and stops working once that campaign ends.

自分の受けた痛みを相手に味わわせる報復用システム。\n某星系で多数の機動兵器に搭.en:
A retaliation system that makes the enemy feel the pain you took.
Fitted to many mobile weapons in some star system, it was hard to use,
and was scrapped after many overdid it and self-destructed. Infamous.

螺旋理論を全ての武装に無理矢理適用させるシステム。\n螺旋理論の効用については現.en:
A system that forcibly applies Spiral Theory to every weapon.
Its effects are still under study, and some researchers claim
the boost is psychological, born of the pilot's love of manly romance.

次元結晶による次元力抽出システム。\n莫大なエネルギー量を得る事が出来るが、常に.en:
A $$次元力$$ extraction system using dimensional crystals.
It yields vast energy, but the constant risk of it running wild
puts an extreme mental strain on the pilot.

極小エリアに次元震を発生させるシステム。\n周辺の空間を歪ませ、様々な防御機構と.en:
A system that creates a dimensional quake in a tiny area.
It warps the surrounding space for use in various defenses, but
some people get symptoms like motion sickness when using it.

亜空間への突入・離脱を応用した移動補助システム。\n並行世界間の移動ほどのエネル.en:
A movement aid system based on entering and leaving subspace.
A pseudo-warp that needs less energy than parallel-world travel,
it also offers the thrill that you might never make it back.

敵を倒した時に感じる高揚感を増幅させるシステム。\n脳内の快楽物質の分泌を促進さ.en:
A system that amplifies the elation felt when defeating an enemy.
It spurs the brain to release pleasure chemicals, so it feels great.
Using it therefore takes strong self-discipline.

パートナーとの絆を強く感じる事が出来るシステム。\n元々は倦怠期の夫婦の関係改善.en:
A system that lets you strongly feel your bond with your partner.
Originally made to mend relations of married couples in a rut, it
was put into use when found to work for any pair of people at all.

人間の生命力そのものから次元力を引き出すシステム。\nただし、そのためには極限ま.en:
A system that draws $$次元力$$ from human life force itself.
However, it requires raising Focus to the very limit,
so the user must have matching strength too.

インサラウムの開発したＺＯＮＥを機体に搭載できるサイズに小型化したもの。\nあら.en:
The $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ developed by $$インサラウム$$, shrunk to fit on a mech.
It taps the $$次元力$$ found everywhere to affect all allies,
but it risks running wild, so it can be used only once per sortie.

次元将ガイオウの身体データから作られた戦闘力強化システム。\nパイロットの成長具.en:
A combat booster built from $$次元将$$ $$ガイオウ$$'s body data.
The mech strengthens as the pilot grows, but past its usage limit,
the pilot is forcibly fused with the mech and meets a terrible end.

次元結晶による次元力抽出システム。\nエネルギーではなく弾薬の補充に使用されるが.en:
A $$次元力$$ extraction system using dimensional crystals.
It replenishes ammo rather than energy, but if misused, rounds can
collide inside the magazine and set off a chain explosion.

武器の発射エネルギーを超空間を通過させる事で射程を伸ばすシステム。\n使用した武.en:
A system that extends range by sending weapon fire via hyperspace.
The fire cuts out, then suddenly reappears just short of the target,
which most confuses veteran pilots; improvements are hoped for.

ＡＤＷにおいて戦乱の火付け役とされた、ある特殊部隊の隊員証。\nＩＤカードとして.en:
The ID of a special unit said to have sparked the wars of the $$ＡＤＷ$$.
Besides serving as ID, it doubled as a fan club card for the unit's
female captain, granting various perks based on combat results.

人間のペルソナを解放するシステム。\n仮面をかぶる事によって世間体や恥、照れから.en:
A system that releases a person's persona.
Behind the mask, free of appearances, shame and shyness, you can show
your hidden self, but serious people often crash from the backlash.

次元商人が使う古今東西のディメンションジョークを集めたもの。\n広い範囲の人間を.en:
A set of timeless Dimension Jokes used by dimensional merchants.
It can relax a whole crowd at once, but it's only a one-shot gag,
so using it more than once will just make people angry.
